name: Uudenvuodenjuoksu
location: Tanelinrannan nuoriso- ja urheilukeskus, Lampitie 10, Seinäjoki
distance_verbose: 10 km, 10 km, 8.2 km, 7.6 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2.4 km, 1.2 km
description: Uudenvuodenjuoksu on upea tilaisuus nauttia liikunnasta uudenvuodenaattona. Tapahtuma järjestetään 31.12.2024 eri paikoissa, kuten Seinäjoella, Limingassa, Liedossa ja Imatralla, ja se tarjoaa osallistujille monipuolisia matkoja eri ikäisille ja tasoisille juoksijoille. Reitit ovat virallisesti mitattuja ja turvallisia, ja niillä on liikenteenohjaus. Tapahtuma kerää yhteen juoksuharrastajia ja tarjoaa myös mahdollisuuden nauttia kahvia ja virvokkeita alueen kioskeista.

images.alt_text: Eurajoen Uudenvuodenjuoksu -juoksija numerolla 323.
Eurajoen Uudenvuodenjuoksu - juoksijat lähtöviivalla.
Eurajoen Uudenvuodenjuoksun lähtö, lumisessa säässä.
Eurajoen Uudenvuodenjuoksu - juoksijoita lumisessa maastossa.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai invites all club members and friends to the 1st New Year’s SEALS MARATHON, which will take place in Pasvalys. This marathon is part of the traditional 18th ice-swimming event organized in Pasvalys District. After the marathon, a club members’ meeting will be held, during which the club’s most active members will be awarded.

name: Talvijuoksu Lappeenranta
description: Talvijuoksusarja on talvijuoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Lappeenrannassa. Tapahtuma alkaa ja päättyy Pallon liikuntahallin vieressä osoitteessa Tukkikatu 2. Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu lähtöpaikalla 20 minuuttia ennen lähtöä, ja tarjolla on eri matkoja: 3 km, 5 km ja 7 km. Lapsille on tarjolla noin 1 km matka, ja kaikki reitit kulkevat valaistua pyörätietä pitkin edestakaisena reittinä. Tapahtuma on ilmainen ja kaikille avoin, pakkasraja on -15 C.

name: Polar Night Marathon
description: The Polar Night Marathon is a spectacular race during the blue hour north of the Arctic Circle. Choose from several distances, from 5 km to the full marathon (42.195 km), and experience the magic of the Arctic's magnificent nature. This race takes place in early January, during the polar night period, when the sun does not rise above the horizon.
course_highlights: Experience the magic of the Arctic's magnificent nature.
Choose from several distances, from 5 km to a full marathon (42.195 km).
The race takes place during the blue hour north of the Arctic Circle.

images.alt_text: Northern lights over Tromsø during the Dark Time Race. Magical!
Runners in the snow during the Mørketidsløpet in Tromsø.
Runners in the Polar Night Run in Tromsø. Snow, darkness, and festive lights.
Runners at the start of the Polar Night Run in Tromsø.

name: Talvijuoksusarja 3/6
description: Talvijuoksusarja 3. osakilpailu järjestetään 30.12.2023 Mikkelissä, ja se tarjoaa juoksijoille mahdollisuuden osallistua eri pituisille matkoille, kuten 10 km ja 6 km. Tapahtuma on suunniteltu erityisesti talviolosuhteisiin, ja se houkuttelee niin kilpa- kuin harrastejuoksijoita. Edellisissä kilpailuissa on nähty erinomaisia suorituksia, ja osallistujat voivat nauttia talvisesta juoksutunnelmasta.

images.alt_text: KOMIA Talvijuoksusarjan 3/6 osakilpailu Mikkelissä. Juoksijat maantiellä.
KOMIA Talvijuoksusarjan juoksijoita Mikkelissä.
Juoksijoita KOMIA Talvijuoksusarjassa. Sateinen päivä.
Juoksija talvijuoksukilpailussa Mikkelissä.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssan Puistojuoksu on jo 30 vuotta kaupungin kuntoa kohottava tapahtuma, johon osallistuu kerran kuukaudessa 100-200 eri ikäistä juoksijaa. Upea reitti kulkee Loimijoen maisemissa ja tarjoaa vaihtoehtoina 5,8 km tai 11,2 km pituiset matkat. Juoksijat starttaavat ja maali on Keskuskadulla, yli satavuotiaan Elävien kuvien elokuvateatterin edustalla.

name: Teivocup III 2027
description: Teivocup III 2027 on kuusiosainen harjoituskilpailu ja testijuoksusarja, joka järjestetään kerran kuukaudessa marraskuusta huhtikuuhun. Tapahtuma tarjoaa juoksumahdollisuuksia eri ikä- ja sarjaryhmille, ja matkat ovat 5 km ja 2 km. Reitti kulkee kevyen liikenteen väylää pitkin, ja lähtö sekä maali sijaitsevat Teivon ravikeskuksen risteyksessä. Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu Lamminpään Ulkoilumajalla, ja kilpailun startti on klo 12.00. Parhaat juoksijat palkitaan.
course_highlights: Reitti kulkee kevyen liikenteen väylää pitkin
Lähtö ja maali Teivon ravikeskuksen risteyksessä
Matkat 5 km ja 2 km eri sarjoille
additional: Ilmoittautuminen Lamminpään Ulkoilumajalla klo 11.30 mennessä, suositellaan saapumaan ajoissa ruuhkan välttämiseksi. Sarjat: 5 km M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50, 2 km P/T 09/11/13. Parhaat palkitaan. Kuusiosainen juoksusarja, rekisteröityminen alkaa klo 11:30, juoksu alkaa klo 12:00.

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: The XXV Run Commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day in Klaipėda is a traditional running event held to honour those who died and fought for Lithuania’s freedom. The event brings together the city’s community and visitors and takes place in Klaipėda on January 18. Participants can choose between two distances: the main 8 km course and a shorter 3 km course for schoolchildren, seniors and anyone who finds the longer course too challenging. The event starts in the evening, and the routes pass through scenic parts of the city, including a cycle path and the Summer Amphitheatre.
course_highlights: The 8 km course follows a cycle path past Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre, Liepojos Street and H. Manto Street
Finish near Klaipėda City Municipality (Liepų St. 11)
The 3 km course starts near Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre and is intended for schoolchildren and seniors
additional: Race bibs have an external timing chip. Picking up race bibs in advance is recommended to avoid queues on event day. Bib pickup for 8 km runners is on a bus near the Rotušė, and for 3 km runners it is near the Summer Amphitheatre. Buses depart for the start locations at 19:00. Individual warm-up: 19:45–19:55. The course closes at 21:20. Medals are awarded to the first 900 finishers. The event is organised with buses and community participation; the start is at the Klaipėda Giruliai Radio and TV Tower.

name: Himos Winter Trail
distance_verbose: 37 km, 25 km, 25 km, 13 km, 13 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km

name: Teivocup IV 2027
description: Teivocup IV 2027 on kuusiosainen harjoituskilpailu- ja testijuoksusarja, joka järjestetään marraskuusta huhtikuuhun kerran kuukaudessa. Tapahtuman neljäs osakilpailu juostaan 6. helmikuuta Lamminpään Ulkoilumajalla Ylöjärvellä. Sarjassa on useita matkoja eri ikä- ja sarjaluokille, ja reitti kulkee kevyen liikenteen väylää pitkin Teivon ravikeskuksen risteyksen läheisyydessä. Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu paikan päällä viimeistään klo 11.30, ja lähtö tapahtuu klo 12.00. Parhaat juoksijat palkitaan.
course_highlights: Reitti kulkee kevyen liikenteen väylää pitkin
Lähtö ja maali Teivon ravikeskuksen risteyksessä
Useita matkoja eri ikä- ja sarjaluokille (5 km ja 2 km)
additional: Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu paikan päällä Lamminpään Ulkoilumajalla viimeistään klo 11.30. Sarjassa on matkat 5 km (M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50) ja 2 km (P/T 09/11/13). Useita kilpailuluokkia, tapahtuma tarjoaa mahdollisuuden osallistua talvijuoksuun suomalaisessa luonnossa.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter
description: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter is a new winter adventure for runners who love nature even when the temperature drops. The race offers three distances on snowy trails in Northern Djurgården with start and finish at Stora Skuggan. All participants who finish will receive a unique winter medal and can enjoy a warming afterrun with hot drinks and snacks. The race suits both competitive runners and those who want to enjoy nature at a slower pace.
course_highlights: Rolling snowy trails in Northern Djurgården
Hydration stations at 6 km and 12 km distances at 4 km
Start and finish at Stora Skuggan with good transportation options
additional: Start and finish at Stora Skuggan, Northern Djurgården. Subway and bus from the city to the start. Hydration stations at 6 km and 12 km distances at 4 km. Warming afterrun with hot drinks and snacks after finishing. Unique medal for all finishers. Terrain, winter conditions, registration via EQ Timing, no cancellations, option to purchase refund protection.

name: Winter Run (Stockholm)
description: Winter Run Stockholm is a winter race that takes place on a unique 5 km course with start and running inside Skansen as well as a loop around Djurgården. The course is partly paved and partly gravel, with a clear elevation gain up to Bollnästorget and some smaller hills on Djurgården. The race encourages participants to compete in luminous and imaginative outfits, creating a festive and colorful atmosphere. The event is organized by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus proceeds go back into sports.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 57% asphalt and 43% gravel
Just over 1 km running inside Skansen
Significant elevation gain up to Bollnästorget
additional: The course is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and measured by an approved course measurer. In icy conditions, shoes suitable for winter conditions are recommended. Any surplus from the race goes back into sports. The event includes opportunities for children and families, with a festive winter atmosphere and entertainment along the course.

name: Bėgimas varžybos „Bėgame už Laisvę“ 2026
description: The “We Run for Freedom” race is a unique running event in Mažeikiai, held to commemorate February 16, the Day of the Restoration of the State of Lithuania. The event promotes an active lifestyle, community, and the celebration of freedom. Participants are invited to join this traditional celebration and run together for freedom.
course_highlights: 10 km road race
The event takes place in Mažeikiai
Held to commemorate February 16
additional: All runners are advised to gather at the 200 m start at 11:35. The event includes various age groups; registration takes place at M. Račkauskas Gymnasium, and participants receive medals.

name: LAPONIE Boreal Winter-Trail Trail To Be Alive
description: Laponie Boreal Winter-Trail on ainutlaatuinen talvinen seikkailu Inarissa, joka tarjoaa osallistujille mahdollisuuden kokea arktinen luonto ja revontulet. Tämä talvinen polkujuoksutapahtuma vie juoksijat upeisiin maisemiin Lapin erämaassa, tarjoten unohtumattomia elämyksiä luonnon keskellä. Tapahtuma on osa Trail to Be Alive -sarjaa, joka tunnetaan laadukkaista ja elämyksellisistä polkujuoksukilpailuistaan eri puolilla maailmaa. Juoksijat voivat odottaa haastavaa mutta palkitsevaa reittiä, joka yhdistää luonnon rauhan ja talven kauneuden.
course_highlights: Arktinen talvinen erämaa Inarissa
Mahdollisuus nähdä revontulia
Haastava polkujuoksureitti luonnon keskellä
additional: Tapahtuma on osa kansainvälistä trail-kiertuetta, mutta tarkempia tietoja reitistä tai rekisteröitymisestä ei ole saatavilla.

name: Teivocup V 2027
description: Teivocup V on talvinen testijuoksukilpailusarja, joka järjestetään Teivon raviradan ympäristössä marraskuusta huhtikuuhun kerran kuukaudessa. Kilpailussa juostaan 5 kilometrin reitti, ja se on suunnattu kaiken tasoisille juoksijoille harrastajista kilpaurheilijoihin. Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu paikan päällä vähintään tuntia ennen starttia, ja osallistumismaksu on 10 euroa per tapahtuma, seuran jäsenille 7 euroa. Sarjassa on miesten ja naisten sarjat sekä yhteisökilpailu.
course_highlights: 5 km juoksureitti Teivon raviradan ympäristössä
Talvinen kilpailusarja marraskuusta huhtikuuhun
Sopii kaikentasoisille juoksijoille harrastajista kilpaurheilijoihin
additional: Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu paikan päällä vähintään tuntia ennen starttia. Sarjassa on miesten ja naisten sarjat sekä yhteisökilpailu. Tapahtuma tarjoaa mahdollisuuden osallistua 5 km juoksuun ja liittyä suomalaiseen juoksuyhteisöön. Osallistumismaksut ja tarkemmat tiedot eivät ole tällä hetkellä saatavilla.

name: 2026 metų Kovo 11-osios bėgimas, skirtas Lietuvos Nepriklausomybės atkūrimo dienai paminėti
location: Gargždų kultūros centras, Gargždai, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
price_range: nemokamai iki IV grupės, 4-5 eurai vėlesnėms grupėms

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: I-III grupės dalyviai ir pensininkai - nemokamai

description: The 2026 March 11 Run is dedicated to commemorating Lithuania’s Restoration of Independence Day and aims to encourage the public to take part in sports and identify the strongest runners in various age groups. The event takes place near Gargždai Cultural Centre, and participants can choose from different distances according to their age and fitness level. The run is open to everyone, with participants starting in groups between 10:00 and 10:30. This traditional event promotes physical activity and brings the community together to mark an important date.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Gargždai Cultural Centre
Different distances from 1.3 km to 14.3 km, according to age group
The course consists of laps, with the number run determined by age group
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:45 to 9:30. Participants start in two groups: Groups I–III at 10:00, and Groups IV–V at 10:30. Registration is online only and closes on March 10 at 20:00. Participants may not be accompanied by bicycles or other vehicles during the run; directional markers will be placed along the course. Various race courses, online registration, awards, traffic management during the event.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 4/5
description: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup on Suomen suurin ja nopein talvijuoksusarja, joka tarjoaa matalan kynnyksen maantiejuoksukilpailuja Vantaan Hakunilassa. Sarja koostuu viidestä osakilpailusta, joissa juostaan 5 km ja 10 km matkoja. Kilpailut houkuttelevat laajan osallistujajoukon, ja ne juostaan virallisesti mitatuilla reiteillä aurinkoisissa kevätsäissä. Sarjapassin ostamalla voi osallistua kaikkiin osakilpailuihin helposti ilman erillistä ilmoittautumista joka kerta. Tapahtuma on perinteikäs ja tarjoaa myös mahdollisuuden juoksukouluihin ja valmennukseen.
course_highlights: Virallisesti mitatut 5 km ja 10 km reitit Vantaan Hakunilassa
Nopeat ja tasokkaat talvijuoksukilpailut
Kilpailut järjestetään aurinkoisissa kevätsäissä ja houkuttelevat laajan osallistujajoukon
additional: Sarjapassin ostamalla osallistuu kaikkiin viiteen osakilpailuun ilman erillistä ilmoittautumista. Kilpailunumerot haetaan kisatoimistolta ja palautetaan jokaisen kisan jälkeen. Vaihtomahdollisuus matkan välillä infopisteellä puoli tuntia ennen lähtöä. Kenttäurheilijat-58 ry:n jäsenet voivat osallistua maksutta sarjapassilla, kun jäsenmaksu on maksettu. Tarkka tapahtuma ja tulokset, ei suoraa mainintaa hinnasta tai radan erityispiirteistä

name: Nuotykių lenktynės „Aplink Rėkyvos ežerą“
description: The “Around Lake Rėkyva” adventure race is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup, held in Šiauliai by Lake Rėkyva. It is a run approximately 14.5 km long, intended for recreational and professional runners, with the aim of promoting running and encouraging a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in spring and is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup series, which includes various races throughout Lithuania. Participants are invited to test their abilities and enjoy the natural scenery around the lake.
course_highlights: An approximately 14.5 km route around Lake Rėkyva
The race takes place in Šiauliai, surrounded by nature
A Lithuanian Running Cup stage for both recreational and professional runners
additional: The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another participant until advance registration closes, subject to a €10 change fee. Registration and entry fee administration is handled by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The event took place on 2026-03-15, but the planned date is 2027-03-21; the course is not marked, participants choose their own route, and navigation and tactics are important.

name: Ursvik Ultra
location: Ursvik, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
price_range: 550 kr för de olika distanserna, efteranmälan 650 kr
description: Ursvik Ultra is a traditional ultramarathon that always takes place on the third Saturday in March. The race offers three distances: 75 km, 45 km, and 15 km, all on a hilly and varied trail with a mix of illuminated tracks and paths. Participants will experience challenging terrain with gravel surfaces that can vary from dry to muddy or snow-covered depending on weather conditions. During the race, food and drinks are available at the lap point, and changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Brotorpshallen. Ursvik Ultra is a perfect start to the ultrarunning season for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 15 km hilly trail with 320 meters of elevation gain
Mix of illuminated tracks, larger and smaller paths
Varying surfaces from dry and hard to muddy and snow-covered
additional: Start takes place at Ursvik trail center. Race packets can be collected from 2 hours before the start. The exchange area is located at the water and food station. Changing rooms and showers are available at Brotorpshallen. Late registration can be done on-site on race day for a fee of 650 SEK. The rope is pulled at 23:30; after that, no one can continue on the course but they can finish on the current lap. The nearest subway station is Hallonbergen, about a 1 km walk to the sports field. Bus 504 stops right outside Motionsgården. The race includes changing, showers, food and drinks, as well as mandatory equipment such as a headlamp and change of clothes. The race takes place on the third Saturday in March, with a transition area at the lap point and free parking for participants.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10 km race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race takes place on a beautifully located course in Norra Djurgården with start and finish near the T-bane station Universitetet. Here, runners can test their form, seed themselves for the adidas Stockholm Marathon, and enjoy a well-organized competition with experienced pacemakers. The course is measured and offers a mix of asphalt, gravel, and ground plates with a total elevation gain of 117 meters.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården with start and finish near Universitetet T-bana
Total elevation gain of 117 meters
Surface: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), ground plates (5.3%), and wooden bridge (0.2%)
additional: Maximum time 2 hours from start. Seeding basis for adidas Stockholm Marathon. Prize money for the top three women and men in the first start group. Age limit 15 years. Walking poles, strollers, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles, handcycles, and racing wheelchairs are not allowed. Wheelchair participants can participate with a companion and free-wheel, starting in the last start group. The race runs on a mix of asphalt, gravel, and ground plates, with a preliminary start around 11:00 and a maximum time of two hours. Registration is open until March 28, 2026, and payment can be made via Swish or credit card.

name: Bėgimas „Runway Run 2026“
location: Lietuvos oro pajėgų bazė, Šiauliai, Lithuania
description: Runway Run 2026 is a 3 km run held at the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. The event offers a unique opportunity to run on a runway, an unusual and exciting place to race. It is intended for school pupils, college students, the community, and the public, promoting an active lifestyle and sports. Participants can enjoy the distinctive atmosphere and test their abilities on this special course.
course_highlights: 3 km run on a runway
Location: Lithuanian Air Force Base, Šiauliai
Unique running course within the airport grounds
additional: The event is intended for school pupils, college students, the college community, and the public. Registration is open, but prices and registration deadlines were not specified. Free parking spaces may be available for students. The event takes place in a setting organized by Šiauliai State College. The event date is April 3, 2027; the distance is 3 km; the location is the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. Registration details were not specified.

name: Komian kirkon hölkkä
description: Komian Kirkon hölkkä on Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry:n järjestämä juoksutapahtuma Ylistaron alueella. Kilpailu tarjoaa monipuolisia reittejä, kuten 5 km, 10 km ja puolimaraton, jotka kulkevat kauniissa maastossa ja tarjoavat vaihtelevia maisemia. Tapahtuma on suosittu paikallisten keskuudessa ja tarjoaa hyvän mahdollisuuden testata kuntoa kevään alussa. Kilpailu on osa Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry:n aktiivista tapahtumakalenteria ja suunnistustoimintaa.
course_highlights: Vaihtelevat reitit: 5 km, 10 km ja puolimaraton
Kauniit ja monipuoliset maastot Ylistaron alueella
Reittikartat saatavilla 5 km ja puolimaraton/10 km reiteille
additional: Kilpailuohjeet juoksijoille, kannustajille, huoltajille ja kökkäväelle löytyvät kilpailuinfo-sivulta. Tulospalvelu ja ilmoittautuneet ovat nähtävissä verkossa. Kilpailun reittikartat ovat saatavilla PDF-muodossa 5 km ja puolimaraton/10 km reiteille. Tapahtuma järjestetään 4. huhtikuuta 2027, ja se sisältää erilaisia kilpailu- ja osallistumismahdollisuuksia. Kilpailun tulokset ja lisätiedot löytyvät tapahtuman verkkosivuilta.

name: Arctic Marathon
description: Arctic Marathon tarjoaa ainutlaatuisen juoksukokemuksen Suomen Lapin upeissa maisemissa. Valittavana on maraton, puolimaraton ja 10 km:n matkat, jotka kulkevat läpi arktisen luonnon. Osallistujat majoittuvat neljän tähden suomalaisissa mökeissä, joissa on sauna, ja nauttivat täysihoidosta sekä monipuolisista aktiviteeteista, kuten huskysafareista, avantouinnista ja revontulien katselusta. Tapahtuma yhdistää urheilun ja elämykset ainutlaatuisella tavalla, ja se on osa kansainvälistä Wildmarathon-sarjaa.
course_highlights: 42 km:n maratonreitti Suomen Lapin luonnossa
Mahdollisuus juosta myös 21 km puolimaraton tai 10 km
Reitti kulkee arktisessa ympäristössä, jossa voi nähdä revontulia
additional: Tapahtumaan sisältyy lentokenttäkuljetukset Rovaniemeltä Santa Claus Holiday Villageen, majoitus 4* mökeissä saunoineen, kaikki ateriat, palkintojenjako, huskysafari, avantouinti ja mahdollisuus nähdä revontulia. Ohjelmassa on myös juoksun jälkeinen sauna- ja jäähdyttelyaktiviteetti sekä rentoutumista. Juoksun lähtö tapahtuu Santa Claus Holiday Villagesta. terrain includes snow roads and forest tracks, temperatures from -12°C to -7°C, recommended gear includes spikes and thermal clothing, registration includes accommodations, meals, transfers, and Arctic experiences

name: Västerås Marathon
description: Västerås Marathon is an energetic and community-oriented running event offering a flat and fast course in Västerås. The race starts in Vasaparken and features a counterclockwise route with some challenging sections, including a steep hill 400 meters from the start. Participants can enjoy water and sports drink stations as well as well-organized bib distribution and baggage drop-off. The event is characterized by running joy and a strong atmosphere, including the national anthem performed from a gondola lift at the start.
course_highlights: The course runs counterclockwise with a steep hill 400 meters from the start
Flat and fast course with some tricky sections, including a tunnel
Strategically placed toilets and hydration stations with water and sports drinks from Umara
additional: Start times: Marathon 9:00, Half Marathon 10:00, 10 km 13:00. Bib distribution and baggage drop-off open at 07:00 in the City Hall restaurant. The central station is 300 meters from the start and finish with good transportation connections. No showers or changing facilities are available. Pacers are used for speed reference with self-seeding in the start area. Medals are awarded to participants. Merchandise can be ordered on demand with shipping included. The race includes water and sports drinks, as well as the opportunity to purchase merchandise. The course passes several local landmarks and is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories with distances of half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km. The start takes place simultaneously at 13:00 from three different locations along national road 34 between Linköping and Motala, with the finish at the sports field Bergvallen in Borensberg. The race is organized by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, and Vreta SoMK, welcoming runners of various ages and levels. Buses transport participants from the finish line back to the start locations before the race. Late registration is possible at the start locations with an additional fee.
course_highlights: Shared start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge, and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the sports field Bergvallen in Borensberg
Bus transport from finish to start locations before the race
additional: Number bibs are collected at each start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30 with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are handed out free of charge to participants up to 16 years old; others can purchase a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish line. The distance is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web and Swish/bank transfer. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants annually.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: SäterMaran is an annual running race in Säter that includes the district championship in the half marathon. The race offers several distances, including the half marathon and 10 km, and is welcoming for runners of various levels. The event is organized by Säters IF FIK and is characterized by a friendly atmosphere with a focus on running joy and local community.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km distances
Low participation in the full marathon, focus on half and 10 km
Held in Säter with scenic surroundings
additional: Registration for the full marathon is closed due to low participation, but registration for the half marathon and 10 km is open as usual.

name: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“
location: Senvagė and Kultūros ir poilsio parkas, Panevėžys, Lithuania
description: The traditional “Senvagė-2026” running competition is part of a Lithuanian Running Cup stage and takes place in Panevėžys, in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park. The event brings together running enthusiasts from various cities to promote sports, a healthy lifestyle, and the discovery of the natural and cultural beauty of Lithuania’s regions. The competition is part of the long-standing Lithuanian Running Cup tradition, which has brought together professional and amateur runners across the country since 2009. The event takes place in spring, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: The competition takes place in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park in Panevėžys
A traditional Lithuanian Running Cup stage featuring runners from various cities
Encourages participants to discover the nature and architecture of Lithuania’s regions
additional: Registration is managed by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another person no later than the close of advance registration. If changing from a more expensive to a less expensive distance, the price difference is non-refundable. The participant change fee is 10 euros. The event will take place at Kranto g. 24, Panevėžys, with online registration available.

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 10 km 12:30 300:-

description: Easter Run is a classic road and trail race organized by Enhörna IF with start and finish at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area. The race has a long tradition and offers several categories for both youth and adults. It is a welcoming competition where participants can enjoy varied terrain and a wonderful running experience in scenic surroundings. Registration is done in advance with the possibility of late registration on site for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Combination of road and trail
Start and finish at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area (sports field)
Several youth categories with shorter distances
additional: Late registration on site is possible up to 60 minutes before each start with an extra fee (100 SEK for adult categories, 50 SEK for youth categories). The Swedish Athletics Federation's competition rules apply. Participation is at your own risk. Names and possible photos may be published on the club's website and social media. The race includes several distances for children, youth, and adults, with registration until the day before the race and the possibility of late registration on site. Results and start lists are published on the club's website and social media.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
location: Studenternas IP, Uppsala, Uppsala Municipality, Sweden
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a fun run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km with start and finish at Studenternas IP. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes participants regardless of training background or level of ambition. It is possible to register individually or in teams, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset has a long tradition since 1989 and is an inclusive environment where women can feel safe and inspired to participate.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP, Ulleråkersvägen 6
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place May 3-5 at Intersport Boländerna. Picnic pickup is done with the team leader's bib number. The event area opens at 17:30 with sponsor booths and activities. There is an option to leave outerwear and shower at the arena. Water stations and toilets are available at the start and finish. The recommended age is 11 years for 2.5 km (in adult company from 7 years) and 13 years for 5 km (in adult company from 11 years). Registration is binding and can be done until race day, no later than 1 hour before start. The event offers optional timing, and all individual participants receive a medal, a finish bag, and a bib. The race is both fitness- and team-friendly and held in an inclusive atmosphere.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby City Run is a popular running event offering a delightful six-kilometer course through Mjölby with start and finish in the City Park. The course runs along the Black River and features both challenging uphill sections and smooth downhill segments, with almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children's race, Bostadsbolaget Little City Run. All participants crossing the finish line receive a medal as proof of their effort. The race is organized by Norrköping Running Club in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cycling Club.
course_highlights: 6 km course with start and finish in City Park, Mjölby
Runs along the Black River for most of the route, 99% asphalt
Includes challenging uphill sections and smooth downhill segments
additional: Number bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday, May 8 from 12:00 to 18:00 with a 25% discount coupon. Warm-up led by Fitness4You before the start. All finishers receive a medal. The children's race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45 for ages up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is possible until May 8 with an additional fee of 50 SEK. Massage services are available at the start and finish areas. The race takes place in City Park, with options for corporate tents, registration via the website, bib pickup at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship opportunities.

name: Springtime Mariestads stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis deltagande för barn upp till årskurs 6 och personer med funktionsvariation

description: Springtime Mariestads Stadslopp is an annual city race organized by Mariestads AIF and Korpen Mariestad since 1982. The race is held in Mariestad at the beginning of May and offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including 10 km, 5 km, children's race, and races for people with disabilities. The event is part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners in various categories. It is a traditional and well-attended running festival with great commitment from officials and participants.
course_highlights: Two main routes: 10 km (2 x 5 km) and 5 km in an urban environment
Children's race and disability race with shorter loops of 500 m and 2000 m
Part of Västsvenska Löparcupen
additional: Start times: Disability race at 10:30, Mini Mari at 11:15, 10 km and 5 km at 12:00. Participation in senior and veteran classes requires membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Association. It is permitted to run together with a guide in the Disability Race. Courses are available via a link on the website. Multiple race distances including 5 km, 10 km, as well as children's and disability races; registration required; medals and prizes for participants.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
price_range: 100 kr rabatt för medlemmar, övriga priser ej specificerade
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a popular running race in Stockholm offering both half marathon and 10 km distances. The race takes place on flat courses around Kungsholmen, making it an excellent opportunity for those aiming for a personal best. The event is a festival with start and finish in Rålambshovsparken, welcoming runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course around Kungsholmen
Start and finish in the scenic Rålambshovsparken
The race offers both half marathon and 10 km distances
additional: The race is a festival with flat courses suitable for personal bests. There is also a kids' race for children. Start and finish are at Rålambshovsparken. Information about bus traffic and road closures is available for participants. Terrain around Kungsholmen, registration via link, kids' race for children up to 13 years old.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a delightful spring race that takes place along the beautiful Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred. The race offers a fantastic natural experience and a wonderful atmosphere, making it perfect for both beginners and experienced runners. It is a welcoming event that invites participation in exercise and community in a scenic environment.
course_highlights: Running along Lake Hulingen
Fantastic natural environment
The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The race is held at Knektavallen, Folkparksvägen 3 in Hultsfred. It is a family-friendly event focused on exercise and health. No specific information about price or registration fee is available on the website. The event includes a 10 km course and children's races, and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. Registration details are available on the website.

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a cross-country race that welcomes all participants, from children and recreational runners to experienced runners and mountain bike cyclists. The race takes place in beautiful terrain along the pine-covered gravel ridge between Alberga and Kungsör, with trails and gravel roads offering moderate elevation changes and technical sections. The event is characterized by an open and welcoming atmosphere, created together by officials, spectators, and participants, and is organized voluntarily by Kungsörs Sports Club. Many return year after year while new participants try for the first time.
course_highlights: Cross-country running and cycling along pine-covered gravel ridge
Trails and gravel roads with moderate elevation changes
Technical sections in nature between Alberga and Kungsör
additional: Late registration opens on the Thursday the week before the race. Start lists for pre-registered participants are available. The race is organized voluntarily by Kungsörs Sports Club with a strong sense of community among participants, officials, and spectators.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 5/5
description: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup on Suomen suurin ja nopein talvijuoksusarja, joka koostuu viidestä osakilpailusta Vantaan Hakunilassa ja Tikkurilassa. Kilpailut tarjoavat matalat kynnyksen maantiejuoksukisat, joissa voi osallistua joko sarjapassilla tai kertamaksulla. Reitti kulkee Sotungin Lukion ympäristössä, ja kilpailukeskuksena toimii Sotungin Lukio. Cupin viimeisessä osakilpailussa palkitaan sarjojen parhaat pisteiden perusteella, ja juoksijoita kannustetaan myös reittiennätyksillä maksettavilla bonuksilla. Tapahtuma on avoin kaiken tasoisille juoksijoille, ja mukana on myös juoksukoulu valmennuksineen.
course_highlights: Reitti kulkee Sotungin Lukion ympäristössä Vantaalla
Kilpailukeskuksena Sotungin Lukio, jossa pukuhuone- ja suihkutilat
Maali-alueella urheilujuomatarjoilu ja kahvio
additional: Sarjapassin ostamalla voi osallistua kaikkiin viiteen osakilpailuun ilman erillistä ilmoittautumista. Kilpailunumerot haetaan kisatoimistolta ja palautetaan jokaisen kisan jälkeen. Palkinnot jaetaan viimeisen osakilpailun jälkeen pisteiden perusteella, ja vähintään kahteen osakilpailuun on osallistuttava kokonaiskilpailun palkinnoille pääsemiseksi. Juoksukoulu tarjoaa valmennusta ja harjoituksia juoksijoille, ja jäsenet voivat osallistua maantiejuoksucupiin maksutta lunastamalla passin etukäteen. Tapahtuma järjestetään Vantaan Tikkurilassa ja sisältää useita kilpailuja, kuten Vitosen ja Kympin. Kilpailut ovat suosittuja paikallisia tapahtumia, jotka tarjoavat mahdollisuuden osallistua matalan kynnyksen maantiejuoksuihin.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt's Marathon in Hultsfred is a personal and welcoming marathon and half marathon race held in celebration of Kurt Gustavsson's 80th birthday and his 300th marathon. The course is a 5-lap park road around Lake Hulingen, consisting of approximately 20% asphalt and is officially measured and sanctioned. The race offers two water stations with water, sports drinks, cola, and energy supplements. After the race, participants are invited to a gathering with food and socializing near the start and finish at Knektavallen.
course_highlights: 5-lap course around Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred
20% of the course is asphalt, the rest is park road
Two water stations with sports drinks, cola, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the entrance of Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. For runners expecting to take over 5 hours, the start time is 09:00. After the race, a gathering with food and socializing is offered around 14:30, approximately 1 km from the start. The race is part of a festive event to honor Kurt Gustavsson and is a unique opportunity for runners to participate in a private, but officially sanctioned competition.

name: Startmilen (Örebro)

price_tiers.distance: 10 km Tävling (Junior, Senior, Veteran M/K35-60) Motion

description: The Start Mile is a recreational race in Örebro suitable for all runners and marks the start of the outdoor season for many. The race offers distances of 1 km for children, 5 km for youth and veterans, and 10 km for competitive classes, with the 10 km also serving as the district championship for Southern Svealand. The start and finish are at Tybblelundshallen near Örebro University, and the course runs on streets in the Almby district. All participants receive a medal, and there are prize ceremonies for different classes.
course_highlights: Start and finish outside Tybblelundshallen near Örebro University
The course runs on streets in the Almby district
The 10 km class is the district championship (DM) for Southern Svealand and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Number bibs are distributed at Tybblelundshallen from approximately 10:30 on race day. Timing is done with a transponder loaned out at bib distribution and must be returned after finishing. Lost transponders are charged at 800 SEK. All classes except KnatteStarten have timing. Late registration is possible until 60 minutes before the start at Tybblelundshallen for an increased fee and subject to availability. Medals are awarded to all finishers. Prize ceremonies are held for the 5 km at 13:40 and the 10 km at 15:30.

name: ÜLEMISTE Grit 2027
organizer: Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia ja Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Virtuaalne osalemine: 24€ (sisaldab medalit, tulemuse haldamise tasu ja saatmiskulu)

description: Ülemiste Grit is an immersive endurance running event held inside Ülemiste Centre in Tallinn. Participants can choose a 1-, 2- or 3-hour challenge, running a 552-metre loop. The event is not a race, but an opportunity to enjoy moving and challenge yourself: you can run, walk or power-walk. There is an aid station on the course offering water, juice and solid food, and a medal and gift bag await at the finish. The event has a limited number of participants and offers a unique indoor running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on the second floor of Ülemiste Centre; each loop is 552 m long.
The indoor course has tiled floors and extensive glass surfaces, so take care.
The aid station offers water, juice, Coca-Cola and solid food (banana, pickles, bread, meat product, chocolate and orange).
additional: Race pack collection takes place from 19:00 to 21:30 on the third floor of the Ülemiste Centre parking garage. Bag storage at the event centre costs €2. Medals and gift bags are handed out at the event centre after finishing. After finishing, participants are asked to stay in the finish area briefly for a group photo. Participants in the 2-hour distance are asked to enter the start area via the first floor (take the escalator near Rimi). The event is sold out; on-site registration is not available. The virtual run option ends on 22.04.2027. Participants can leave their own drinks bottles along the course, labelled with their names. The event is non-competitive and emphasises cooperation and safety. Participants receive gift bags; the course is designed to be an experience, not for chasing records.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly fitness event in Stockholm featuring races for all ages, including Mini-race for the youngest children, the Little Skärholmsloppet for children in preschool class up to grade 6, a 5 km timed race for participants aged 13 and older, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The race is organized by Löparakademin, a non-profit organization working with youth in immigrant neighborhoods for personal development through running. Throughout the day, there will be music and entertainment with DJs along the course, and all participants will receive a medal at the finish line. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive and encouraging running experience that promotes movement and equal health.
course_highlights: 5 km timed race for ages 13 and up
Little Skärholmsloppet approximately 1.6 km for children in preschool to grade 6
Mini-race of 500 meters for children 0-6 years, with the opportunity to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplan. Start times: Mini-race at 10:30, Little Skärholmsloppet from 11:30 in different start groups by age, Fun Run 1.6 km starting at 12:25, 5 km race starting at 13:00. All participants receive a medal and energy at the finish. Registration is free and can be done until May 14 at 17:00, with late registration possible at bib distribution and on race day if spots are available. Music and DJs along the course for extra motivation. The race takes place at Puckelbollplan in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants will receive a medal after finishing.

name: TEC 200 miles
description: TEC 200 miles is a challenging ultramarathon held in Tyresö, with start and turnaround at Alby Friluftsgård. The course is a 11.5 km loop offering hilly terrain, technical trails, and beautiful views of Lake Albysjön, Tyresta Nature Reserve, and Tyresö-Flaten. The race is part of the Tyresö Extreme Challenge, which offers several distances including Backyard Ultra, MiniUltra 46 km, 50 miles, and 100 miles. It is a race that combines tough challenges with a wonderful community and positive energy among runners and volunteers.
course_highlights: 11.5 km loop with start and finish at Alby Friluftsgård
Hilly gravel roads and technical trails with roots and stones
Spectacular views of Lake Albysjön, Tyresta Nature Reserve, and Tyresö-Flaten
additional: Start and turnaround are at Alby Friluftsgård in Tyresö. The course is marked with orange reflective ribbons spaced 20-70 meters apart. Runners pass a tent with a buffet and volunteers at the turnaround, but are advised not to stay too long. The race takes place all weekend with multiple distances, and the start time for 200 miles is at 10:00 on race day. The event is held in mid-April and may require endurance in difficult weather conditions, including icy or cold conditions early in the season.

name: Tjust Trail Run
location: Västervik, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organized by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging and sweaty competition on winding trails, over beautiful rocky outcrops, and through scenic Småland nature. Participants will experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running on technical and hilly trails. Welcome to a wonderful running experience in a picturesque environment with good atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Winding trails through Småland forest
Technical sections with elevation and rocks
Passage through forest tunnel and muddy holes
additional: Changes to the distance are possible until April 10 via email. Cut-off time for the longest distance (The Long Run) with lap at 11:45. Bib number must be clearly visible. Recommended equipment is trail running shoes and mobile phone. In case of interruption, contact volunteers or the phone number from the bib distribution. Transportation is arranged from water stations if needed.

name: Varvetmilen Sollentuna
location: Strandvägen to Sollentunavallen, Sollentuna, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Varvetmilen Sollentuna is a 10 km race that challenges you to run your best mile in Sollentuna. The course runs through the town, south along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen, with a water station at 5 km. The final part of the course is beautifully situated along the water on Nils Göranssons promenade before finishing at Sollentunavallen. The results from Varvetmilen are seedings for Göteborgsvarvet 2026, giving you the opportunity to secure a better starting group.
course_highlights: The course runs through Sollentuna town, south along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen
Water station at 5 km
The final part of the course runs along the water on Nils Göranssons promenade
additional: Start and finish area at Sollentunavallen and Strandvägen near the water. Bib number distribution and baggage drop-off take place on site on race day. The mini race for children 0-6 years old is held simultaneously with a 210-meter race, registration on site (80 SEK via Swish). The race is an important seed race for Göteborgsvarvet and offers facilities such as bib number pickup and baggage drop-off.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Spring Run is a beautiful spring running event held amid the ancient natural landscapes of the Kõrvemaa Nature Reserve. The event centre is conveniently located near Tallinn at the Sportland Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre. The varied routes include a 16 km main distance, a 6 km run and a youth run. Free children’s runs, activities for the whole family and childcare are also available. After the run, participants can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and hot tubs, as well as an exciting treasure hunt at Anija Manor.
course_highlights: The entire route runs through a nature reserve
A range of distances: 16 km, 6 km and a youth run
Event centre conveniently located near Tallinn
additional: Free bus transport is provided for participants between Aegviidu railway station and the event centre, in both directions. The event centre has childcare, a bag drop, a Stebby wellbeing area with Fysiotikker, and a Sportland pop-up shop where you can top up on running gear. For children, Aegviidu RMK offers nature-themed activities, a low ropes course, a mini-pancake café, and horse and pony rides (bring cash). A sauna and hot tubs will be open after the run. Participants can enter a draw to win a stylish Trek city bike at the Spring Run awards ceremony at 14:00. Group discounts: 10% off when registering at least 5 participants, and 20% off when registering at least 10 participants. A 50% discount is available for seniors (60+) and young people (up to 17) when registering in advance; the minimum final price is €15. The event takes place on 25 April 2027, offering a choice of distances and the chance to enjoy outdoor exercise and time with family.

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
description: Spring Ruset in Stockholm is a recreational race for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km in Norra Djurgården. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes everyone regardless of training background or level of ambition. It is possible to register individually or in teams, with team registrants receiving a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition since 1989 and aims to promote women's health and create an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Norra Djurgården
Start and finish at Frescatiängen near Stockholm University
The race takes place on gravel and forest trails in a scenic environment
additional: Number bibs are sent by mail upon registration before April 17, otherwise they can be picked up on site. Teams of five people receive a picnic after finishing. Changing rooms and showers are available at cost. The recommended age is 13 years for the 5 km and 11 years for the 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. It is possible to opt out of timing during registration. The event area is easiest to reach on foot, by bike, or public transport. Parking is limited and not recommended. The event is part of Sweden's largest sports tour for girls and focuses on community and health.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race with start, exchange, and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping where teams of four participants each run an exciting four-kilometer stretch. The race offers a great team spirit with men's, women's, and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course is close to the competition center with motivational music along the route and audience support at exchanges and the finish. It is an evening filled with exercise, community, and joy, where children and youth can participate for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchange, and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on an exciting course near the competition center
Motivational music along the route and audience support at exchanges and the finish
additional: Helhetshälsan offers leg massages both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes are awarded to the first team in each class, and nice prizes are raffled among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides energy-rich products after the finish. The race is held in Folkparken, with the possibility of late registration on site, and participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-rich products after the race.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a recreational run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km through central Västerås with start and finish at Lögastrand. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes everyone regardless of training background or level of ambition. Registration can be done individually or as a team, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. The event is part of a long tradition since 1989 and aims to promote women's health and create an inclusive environment for exercise and socializing.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at Intersport in the Livli shopping center Erikslund in the days before the race. There is supervised baggage drop-off, water stations, and toilets at the event area. Picnic pickup is done with the team leader's number bib. The recommended age is 13 years for the 5 km and 11 years for the 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. It is possible to opt out of timing during registration. Training sessions are organized in several locations before the race. Participants receive a number bib, finish bag, and medal; teams of 5 people; open to runners, joggers, and walkers; registration via the web; the event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: Blodcentralen i Östergötland och IK Akele samt Blodtappen i Östergötland
description: The Blood Race in Linköping is one of Sweden's largest sporting events focused on raising awareness of the vital need for blood donation. The race offers the opportunity to walk, jog, or run 5 or 10 kilometers and is open to both individual participants and teams. During the event, the blood bus will be on site for those who wish to become blood donors, and the race has a strong local connection with ambassadors and collaborations. It is a social and healthy activity that concludes with a communal picnic and contributes to youth activities through the proceeds.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in Linköping
Opportunity to register as a blood donor on site via the blood bus
The race is organized for the twenty-second time with a local ambassador
additional: Youth teams (five team members born in 2009 or later) participate at half the registration fee if registered by April 30. Teams can be expanded to five participants at no cost until April 30. Participants registering by May 14 will receive free public transport within Östergötland for 6 hours on race day via SMS ticket. Late registration is possible at the bib distribution days before the race. Payment can be made via Swish, card, or e-invoice for companies. The race includes various distances for adults and children, with options to walk or run, as well as blood donation on site. The event is a large community celebration with music and social gathering.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging trail race of 5 km with 300 meters of elevation gain in beautiful and technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course offers nice trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The start is at the old football field, and the race includes steep climbs, singletrack, and scenic views over Ågelsjön. Welcome to participate in this somewhat classic race that provides a real challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 meters of elevation in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep climbs
Beautiful view over Ågelsjön and passage by Eremiten's Jakob's Cave
additional: The start is at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each class as well as raffle prizes. A ballpark is located 200 meters from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are offered as add-ons. The course's technical sections include "Koklämman" with a rope for assistance uphill, and the race passes a cozy barbecue area under a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk, course description includes climbs and trail sections.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: Adidas Premiärhalvan is a half marathon of 21.1 km held in Stockholm on April 25, 2026. The race starts at 11:00 AM and has a maximum time of three hours, with start and finish areas at Biskopsudden. The course runs around Southern Djurgården and passes through scenic natural areas near central Stockholm. The event is organized by Marathongruppen and is seen as a good preparation for the adidas Stockholm Marathon, while also welcoming all who want to experience springtime in a beautiful city environment. Registration is available at different price levels (495-745 SEK), and bib and start information are shared in advance; water stations and medical personnel are available along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs around Southern Djurgården with start and finish at Biskopsudden
Beautiful spring environment and scenic views near central Stockholm
Mixed surface with asphalt, gravel, and cobblestones along the course
additional: The race is a preparation for the adidas Stockholm Marathon and includes bib distribution in advance as well as start information. Water stations and medical personnel are available along the course. The maximum time is 3 hours and the age limit is 17 years. The deadline for reporting results for seeding is March 31. The course is a single lap of 21.1 km around Southern Djurgården (asphalt/gravel/cobblestones) and sports drinks from Enervit are offered along the course.

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
description: Munkastigen Trailrun is organized by Laxå OK and will take place on Saturday, April 25, 2026, starting in Olshammar. On the race page, there are maps, elevation profile, and a GPX file available for download to plan your run. Invitations and registration links are published during the current year in the menu on the club's page. Welcome to participate and access course information before the race.
course_highlights: Start in Olshammar
Maps (Map Part 1 and Map Part 2) and elevation profile available
GPX file available for download (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx, thanks Jonas Brännmyr)
additional: Invitations and registration links are published during the current year in the menu on the page. Course information includes Map Part 1 and Part 2 as well as elevation profile. GPX file (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx) is available for download. The race runs from Olshammar on the shores of Vättern to Laxå in Tiveden. Teams consist of 2 - 5 runners with relay points at any location along the course. SI-pins are recommended or can be rented. Start and finish: start at 11:00 in Olshammar, finish at Laxå OK's clubhouse.

description: Lidingöloppet Spring Mile is a spring race of 5 and 10 kilometers with start and finish at Lidingövallen. The course is called one of Stockholm's most beautiful mile routes and runs through winding forest roads, meadows, and along the archipelago coast, mostly on soft trails and sometimes hilly. The race serves as a qualifying event for TCS Lidingöloppet and is suitable for those wanting to check their fitness or secure a better starting group. Before and after the race, coffee and light food are available for purchase at the café at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest roads past meadows and along the archipelago coast
Mostly soft trails; hilly (10 km 127 m elevation, 5 km 52 m elevation)
Water station at 5 km and at the finish; course marked with red/white ribbons and km flags
additional: Number bib distribution from 09:30 on race day until 30 minutes before start. Late registration is available at Lidingövallen from 09:30 and no later than 60 minutes before start. Name and class changes can be made via Mina sidor for a fee (details and fees are on the website) or on-site for a higher fee. Free baggage drop-off is available; baggage storage costs 20 SEK (Swish 1235557608). Parking near Lidingövallen is limited (fee 40 SEK via Swish 1234575775); the organizer recommends public transport (metro to Ropsten + bus 204/211/212). Changing rooms, showers, and sauna are available indoors at Lidingövallen. Course surface: asphalt for the first 2.5 km, then gravel and trails; last 350 m on the running track. Distances are 5 km and 10 km; Kids' Spring Run for younger participants; water station at 5 km and water supplies at the finish; seeding for TCS Lidingöloppet.

name: Vårmilen
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott / Lidingöloppet Marknads AB
description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a popular running challenge offering one of Stockholm's most beautiful mile courses. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on winding forest paths, meadows, and along the archipelago coast. The course is mostly soft and hilly, making the race a gentle and scenic start to the running season. The race also serves as a qualifying event for TCS Lidingöloppet, providing an opportunity for a better starting group in the autumn's classic cross-country race. During the race, there are water stations with water and sports drinks, as well as entertainment along the course.
course_highlights: Winding forest paths and meadows
Running along the archipelago coast
Mostly soft trails with elevation
additional: Start and finish at Lidingövallen. Water and sports drink stations at 5 km and at the finish. Group warm-up before start. Bag drop-off available free of charge, valuables drop-off costs 20 SEK. Changing rooms with showers and sauna available. The course is marked with white ribbons and spray paint, with officials at difficult sections. It is recommended to travel by public transport or bicycle due to limited parking. Category and name changes can be made for a fee before and on race day. Cross-country course, hilly, start and finish at Lidingövallen, accessible by public transport and car, limited parking.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Welcome to Bålsta City Race, held on April 26, 2026 at Gröna Dalens IP in Bålsta. The race is known as a fast, spectator-friendly course where many have set personal bests - the course is organized by Bålsta IK and has grown every year since its start in 2019. The competition offers the Sparbanksloppet 5 km (possible one lap) and 10 km (two laps) with the finish inside the Gröna Dalens athletics track. The organizer emphasizes speed, joy, and a friendly event atmosphere for both elite and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 5 km loop that can be run once or twice (resulting in 5 km or 10 km total)
Approximately 99% asphalt; finish inside the athletics track at Gröna Dalens IP
Known as a fast course where many have achieved personal records and several course records are documented
additional: Number bib distribution takes place inside Gröna Dalens IP from 08:00. Late registration can be done digitally subject to availability until 1 hour before each start on race day. Start and finish are located at Gröna Dalens sports field (Badhusvägen); commuter train (line 43) to Bålsta station is about 850 meters walk from the venue. There are several parking options within 100 - 900 meters; Badhusvägen will be closed during the race day. There is clothing drop-off (instructions to attach the lower part of the bib to the bag), limited changing/shower facilities, and toilets near the venue. Sports drinks (Umara) and water are available at the turn-around for the 5 km race. A team competition for the 5 km (Sparbanksloppet) is introduced; the course is described as fast and PB-friendly.

name: Kvantumloppet (Kvantumloppet med Trail 7+17km)
description: Kvantumloppet is Huddinge AIS Athletics' running festival at Källbrinks IP, open to all levels with both shorter recreational runs and technical trail options. The event offers a kids' class, recreational runs of 3 and 5 km, as well as trail runs of 7 and 17 km, welcoming both casual runners and more experienced trail runners. The course mostly runs on smaller forest paths and features sections of technical terrain with stones, roots, and steep inclines, as well as several scenic parts. Prizes are awarded to the fastest woman and man in several categories, and all finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Mostly runs on smaller forest paths, partly very technical with stones, roots, and steep inclines
Several scenic sections along the course
17 km follows Gömmaren's black/white trails "SKATAN"
additional: Date and location: April 26 at Källbrinks IP (Gamla Stockholmsvägen 91, Huddinge). Start times: Kids' class 700 m at 11:00; Trail 17 km at 11:10; Recreational 3 and 5 km at 12:00; Trail 7 km at 12:00. Prizes: Trophy for the first woman and man to finish in the 3 km, 5 km, and Trail 7 km and 17 km; medals for all finishers. Large prize table from ICA Kvantum Kungens Kurva where bib numbers serve as raffle tickets; award ceremony around 13:00; practical prizes and medals for the kids' class immediately after finishing. Organizer: Huddinge AIS (contact: pelle@huddingeais.se, phone 0706758799). Registration by April 19, 2026; team discount for at least 5 participants; bibs are picked up on race day; results available at kvantumloppet.se

name: STHLM Trail Run
course_highlights: Beautiful forest trail through Northern Djurgården with natural terrain challenges
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Easily accessible by public transport (reachable from Ropsten; close to Stureplan by bike)
additional: Distances: 5 km (start 11:00, age limit 13 years, 11 years with guardian) and 10 km (start 12:00, age limit 15 years, 13 years with guardian). Event area: Fisksjöäng, Northern Djurgården. Medal, finish line service, bib with timing, and refreshments along the course. Registration is personal and can be done digitally up to 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: Swish, Visa/MasterCard, Klarna invoice. Start times: 5 km at 11:00 (age limit 13 years, 11 years with guardian) and 10 km at 12:00 (age limit 15 years, 13 years with guardian). Included: medal, finish line service, bib with timing, and refreshments along the course; registration is possible until 1 hour before the first start.

name: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“
description: The Palanga Half Marathon “OUTRUN THE HORSE” is a high-quality half-marathon event held in celebration of St. George’s Day. The event aims to establish Palanga as a European City of Sport and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors. The race takes place in the resorts of Palanga and Šventoji, expanding the range of mass sporting events and encouraging local community participation in sports.
course_highlights: Start in Šventoji and finish in Palanga
The course is marked and adapted for runners
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and popularizes sports
additional: Traffic restrictions and public relations campaigns are planned to ensure the event runs smoothly.

description: Värmlandsstafetten in Karlstad is a two-hour relay race where teams of 5 to 15 participants pass a baton around Sundstatjärn on a flat lap course approximately 1,270 to 1,300 meters long. The race starts at 6:00 PM with the goal of transporting the baton to the finish within two hours at the arena in Karlstad, with start and finish at the arena. Teams decide how many laps each person runs and switch after each lap; in the first year, a logo relay baton is purchased that follows the team each year. Register your team and participate in a social, health-promoting evening that contributes to community and team spirit.
course_highlights: Flat lap course around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 - 1,300 meters per lap
Team competition for 5 - 15 participants with switching after each lap and two hours at the arena
Start and finish at the arena; option to order a logo relay baton that follows the team
additional: The course around Sundstatjärn is approximately 1,270 meters per lap (just under 1,300 meters), asphalt surface. Tents and parking are available at the arena/Sundstabadet. Start/finish at the arena; two hours to transport the baton to the finish. The course runs around Sundstatjärn in Karlstad, with each lap measuring about 1,270 meters. Each team consists of at least 5 and at most 15 participants, with the start at 6:00 PM and two hours to complete the relay and transport the baton.

name: Valio Helsinki City Run
description: Valio Helsinki City Run on Suomen suurin juoksutapahtuma, joka kokoaa Helsingin Olympiastadionille ja kaupungin kaduille yli 24 000 juoksijaa yli 110 maasta. Tapahtuma tarjoaa kuusi erilaista juoksumatkaa, mukaan lukien maraton, puolimaraton, maratonviesti, 5 km juoksu ja kävely sekä lasten Minimarathon. Reitit ovat kauniita ja merellisiä, ja maali sijaitsee Olympiastadionilla. Tapahtuma tarjoaa myös monipuoliset palvelut, kuten kansainvälisen tason ajanoton, huoltopisteet ja ilmaisen sisäänpääsyn Uimastadionille juoksun jälkeen.
course_highlights: Kauniit ja merelliset reitit Helsingissä
Maali ja tapahtumakeskus Olympiastadionilla
Virallisesti mitatut AIMS-sertifioidut reitit
additional: Juoksunumeroiden nouto Olympiastadionilta ennen juoksua, mahdollisuus maksaa liikuntaeduilla (ePassi, Edenred, Zevoy Benefits), ryhmäilmoittautumisessa vähintään 5 juoksijaa, ryhmille ilmaiset tapahtumapaidat vähintään 10 hengen ryhmille, ilmainen sisäänpääsy Uimastadionille juoksun jälkeen, huoltopisteet ja geelit reitillä, mahdollisuus ostaa peruutusvakuutus, ilmaisia yhteistreenejä ja harjoitusohjelmia, kansainvälisen tason ajanotto (pois lukien kävely). Tapahtuma sisältää useita eri matkoja, kuten maratonin, puolimaratonin, 5 km:n juoksun ja kävelytapahtumia. Osallistujat voivat seurata reaaliaikaisia tuloksia ja hakea diplomeita heti maalissa. Tapahtuma järjestetään Olympiastadionilla ja siihen liittyy myös tapahtuma-viikko aktiviteetteineen ja sponsorointimahdollisuuksineen.

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėda EKOMarathon is a traditional running event held on the forest trails of Giruliai in Klaipėda. Both amateur and professional runners can take part, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. Distances range from 2 km for schoolchildren to 42.2 km for Ekomarathon participants, who run 10 laps of 4.2 km each. The event is organized by the Klaipėda city running club “Maratonas” and supported by Klaipėda City Municipality.
course_highlights: Ekomarathon course: 10 laps of 4.2 km on the forest trails of Giruliai
Schoolchildren’s course: 2 km (1 km out, 1 km back)
Start in Giruliai Forest, at the beginning of the bike path beyond the Summer Stage
additional: On race day, the timing system operates until 15:00. The entry fee is paid on site when collecting the race number. The first 300 participants receive commemorative medals; all participants receive certificates. Participants must bring an identity document to collect their race number. Participants agree that event organizers may use photographs and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. 4.2 km and 42.2 km distances, 2 km schoolchildren’s race, start in Giruliai Forest, online registration until April 30.

name: RAHOLAN KYMPPI (TAMPERE)
location: Tampereen Tesoman jäähallin parkkipaikka, Tampere, Pirkanmaa, Finland
description: Raholan Kymppi on vuosittain Tampereen Tesoman jäähallin parkkipaikalta starttaava 10 kilometrin juoksutapahtuma. Se tarjoaa juoksijoille mahdollisuuden nauttia reitistä, joka on perinteinen ja suosittu paikallisten keskuudessa. Tapahtuma on osa Team Raholan järjestämää juoksukalenteria ja houkuttelee monipuolisen osallistujajoukon. Juoksu on hyvä tilaisuus testata kuntoa kevään aikana ja kokea yhteisöllisyyttä juoksutapahtumassa.
course_highlights: 10 kilometrin mittainen reitti
Startti ja maali Tampereen Tesoman jäähallin parkkipaikalla
Perinteinen ja suosittu paikallinen juoksutapahtuma
additional: Team Raholan maanantain yhteislenkit Tesoman jäähallilta klo 18.00 tarjoavat harjoitusmahdollisuuden. Juoksutapahtuman yhteydessä ei ole erikseen mainittuja lähtöaikoja tai hintatietoja. Team Rahola tarjoaa myös muita juoksutapahtumia ja harjoituksia, kuten Cooperin testin ja viikkotapahtumia. Tapahtuma järjestetään Tampereen Tesoman jäähallin parkkipaikalla, ja osallistujat voivat juosta tai kävellä. Kilpailu tarjoaa mahdollisuuden nauttia liikunnasta luonnon ja kaupungin yhdistelmää ympäristössä.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: The 45th Tartu Forest Marathon is a traditional event held at the Tartumaa Sports Centre, offering participants the chance to enjoy trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. The event is part of Estonia’s programme to promote recreational physical activity and is suitable for runners of different abilities who want to improve their fitness and mental well-being. The marathon highlights the importance of physical activity for maintaining health and well-being and invites everyone who leads an active lifestyle to take part. It is organised by the Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity, which supports the development of a healthier and more active society in Estonia.
course_highlights: Trail running through the beautiful forest landscapes of the Tartumaa Sports Centre
A varied and changing course suitable for runners of different abilities
An opportunity to enjoy nature and improve mental and physical health
additional: The event takes place at the Tartumaa Sports Centre. Participants can register and collect their race numbers at Turu 10 in Tartu and in the car park at Aura Centre.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra is a welcoming Backyard Ultra race held in Trekantsparken, Liljeholmen in Stockholm, organized by Run Raisers with proceeds for #Run4Diabetes. The race takes place on a 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken with mixed terrain and a new start every full hour; participants must complete the loop within 1 hour to start the next. The event offers an energy station, medal, goodie bag, and organizer support throughout the race. The start is at 14:00 on May 1, 2026.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken (start/finish in Trekantsparken, near Liljeholmen metro station)
Mixed terrain: trails with wooden bridges, gravel roads, and paved walk/cycle paths
A steep uphill at Örnberget and illuminated trail along Vinterviken
additional: Registration opens August 1. Name changes can be made until April 17, 2026, for a fee of 150 SEK (done via info@runraisers.com with new participant details). Bib distribution takes place on Thursday, April 30. Race format: mass start every full hour; those who do not complete the loop within 1 hour are out. The registration fee includes an energy station, race photos, medal, and goodie bag; 20% of the fee goes to #Run4Diabetes. The race is a charity event supporting Run4Diabetes; 20% of the registration fee is donated to Run4Diabetes; includes aid station, medal, race photos, goodie bag, and prizes for winners.

name: Sevede Trail Run
description: Sevede Trail Run is a welcoming trail race in Mariannelund organized by Hässleby SOK. The race offers a challenging course mostly run on narrow trails in the beautiful Småland landscape - through dark, fairy-tale forests, along lakes, and over long cliffs with fast downhill sections. There are categories for men and women at 10 km and 26 km, as well as a children's race of about 1 km. Everyone is welcome to register until race day; the children's race is free and awards a medal at finish.
course_highlights: Mostly narrow trails in Småland landscape
Through dark, fairy-tale forests and along lakes
Long cliffs and fast downhill sections
additional: Registration opens at 08:00 at Slättvallen in Mariannelund. Registration is via email to sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com and payment is accepted via Swish (123-358 26 99). Late registration can be done on-site on race day. The children's race is about 1 km, all children run for free and receive a medal and a banana at the finish; a parent can accompany the child. Distance options: 26 km and 10 km; start window Saturday 10:00 - 16:00; contact: sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com; 2025 estimated number of participants approximately 45; 2024 women's course record at 26 km is 2:10:07 by Emelie Braf; children's race with many participants; results and photos are available.

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a Backyard Ultra on a light and fast lap course in central Trosa where each lap is 6.706 km and the race continues as long as participants can complete a lap within one hour. The start is on May 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM and the concept follows the Backyard format: those who complete a lap within an hour can start again until only one participant remains. The race is open to the public and family-friendly with Mini-TUB for children (start at 12:15 PM) and awards for the top three in men's and women's categories. The organizer offers sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches at the lap change, and has ongoing raffles during the race.
course_highlights: Lap of 6.706 km (large course)
Mostly follows the Trosaån and is very easy and flat (approximately <10 meters elevation gain)
Mini-TUB: approximately 700 m course for children (MiniTUB follows the large course 700 m before deviation)
additional: Start and finish at Västra hamnplan in Trosa; livestream on Facebook page Trosa Ultra Backyard; Mini-TUB sponsored by Camfil; team competition where the top three results count for each club (the club with the top three gets 20% discount next year); tent spaces outside the start area; limited motorhome spaces; no caravan spaces; food and energy support during the race (candy, sports drinks, fruit) and Selfie-Corner after the race; free silicone mug from Umara for all main race participants.
