tiers.description: 14/9 till 18/9 Löplabbets butik på Dragarbrunns Torg 6. Endast swish-betalning! Lilla Kung Björn 95 kr.

description: Uppsala Running Club welcomes elite runners, recreational runners, and children of all ages to the King Bear Race - Uppsala's cross-country race with the family at the center. The race is organized at OK Linné's club house and offers several distances (10 km, 6 km, trail run, and children's race). The event now has fixed times, bib number distribution with electronic chips, and prize giving, with the 20th anniversary of the race in 2026.
course_highlights: Mostly gravel roads and forest trails, with sections of asphalt
Three distances: approximately 10 km, just over 6 km, and trail run about 5 km; courses have kilometer markers
Water stations: two at 10 km, one at 6 km; water also available at the finish
additional: Bib numbers with electronic chips can be collected at Löplabbet, Dragarbrunns Torg 6 on Friday, September 19 from 12:00 to 18:30 or on race day from 09:00 until one hour before each start (30 minutes before children's races). Those who pick up on Friday receive a 20% discount on regular prices in Löplabbet's store (excluding electronics). Parking is available for a fee; the organizer recommends public transport (bus line 7) or cycling. There are changing rooms and showers with limited space, a kiosk on site, prize giving around 13:30, and a prize draw. Start groups: 10 km has start group 1 (under 50 minutes) and group 2; 6 km starts in a combined group. Members who have contributed at least one work shift can register free of charge via kb.loppet@gmail.com. Water stations, bib number pickup at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 6), Swish payment, start times: 11:00 (10 km), 12:00 (6 km), 12:15 (trail); prize giving around 13:30; medals for all finishers; parking for a fee; public transport or cycling recommended; no timing in children's races.

name: Kistaloppet
description: Kistaloppet is a family-friendly city-based running event organized by Löparakademin with races for all ages: Kistaloppet 5 km, Lilla Kistaloppet/Fun Run 1.6 km, and Kistaloppet MINI for the youngest participants. The courses offer a varied running experience through the high-rise buildings of the Million Programme, the green areas of Järvafältet, and Kista's IT cluster, with start and finish at Jan Stenbecks torg near Kista Galleria. The event emphasizes accessibility and community (including the #RUN4ZERO initiative) and is designed for both recreational runners and those who want to compete on the controlled 5 km course. The event is usually complemented by music, entertainment, and a festival atmosphere along the route.
course_highlights: Controlled 5 km course through Kista: high-rise buildings, Järvafältet green areas, and the IT cluster
Start and finish centrally at Färögatan near Jan Stenbecks torg, adjacent to Kista Galleria
Music stations/DJs and entertainment along the route for a festival atmosphere
additional: Registration is free and includes a medal; registration is open until September 17 (subject to availability). Bib distribution at the competition center in Kista Galleria (opposite McDonald's): Friday, September 19, 12:00 - 18:00 and Saturday, September 20, 09:15 - 13:00 (bib must be picked up at least 30 minutes before start). Water stations are available at the finish line; medical personnel are on site. Only the adult class (Kistaloppet 5K) has official timing; other races, including Fun Run, are non-timed. Volunteers are expected to be available approximately 09:00 - 15:30. Races for the whole family: 5K, LILLA Kistaloppet, Kistaloppet MINI, and Fun Run; registration is free; Lilla Kistaloppet is approximately 1.6 km and MINI 500 m; medals are awarded to all finishers of Lilla Kistaloppet; start times and bib pickup at Kista Galleria.

name: Coop Eskilstunarunt
description: A flat course without hills, offering a chance for good times along the river in central Eskilstuna. Start and finish in the city park.

images.alt_text: Starten av Coop Eskilstunarunt, ett terränglopp i centrala Eskilstuna.
Coop Eskilstunarunt startportal med löpare i parken.
Barn och vuxna startar Coop Eskilstunarunt i stadsparken.
Coop Eskilstunarunt startbåge med löpare.
Löpare vid startlinjen under Coop Östras banderoll för Coop Eskilstunarunt.
Deltagare i Coop Eskilstunarunt som springer under startbågen i stadsparken.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOKs klubbstuga Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an urban ultramarathon in Västerås offered at several distances: 100 miles (161 km), 50 miles (80.5 km), Intro Ultra (48 km), 20 miles (32.2 km), and 10 miles. The start, turnaround, and finish are at Västerås SOK's clubhouse Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers, and a sauna. The course consists of a varied loop of 10 miles (16.1 km) with technical trails, jogging tracks, gravel roads, hiking trails, and sections of asphalt. The race is organized by Västerås Running Club and offers rewards such as a medal for completing the race and a belt buckle for 100 miles under 24 hours.
course_highlights: One lap = 10 miles (16.1 km); the race is run in repeated laps
Very varied terrain: technical trails, jogging tracks, gravel roads, hiking trails, and some asphalt
City-close course with start/turnaround/finish at Västerås SOK's clubhouse Orientalen
additional: Distances: 100 miles, 50 miles, Intro Ultra (48 km), 20 miles, and 10 miles. Start/turnaround/finish at Västerås SOK's clubhouse Orientalen with changing rooms, showers, and a sauna. 100-mile runners who complete the course within 24 hours receive BRR's belt buckle; others who finish receive a medal. Participants can opt out of the medal, in which case the organizer will donate 20 SEK to Doctors Without Borders. The distances include 100 miles, 50 miles, Intro Ultra 48 km, 20 miles, and 10 miles; the course is permanently marked with red posts; start and finish at Orientalen; 24-hour time limit for 100 miles; sauna and showers in the clubhouse.

name: Fredsloppet
description:
The race takes place on a nice, relatively flat asphalt loop at Ålidhem.

Fredsloppet is not a typical running competition. It is also an easy way to stand up for peace, solidarity, and justice.
course_highlights: The race is held on a flat asphalt loop at Ålidhem.
Fredsloppet promotes peace, solidarity, and justice.

name: Coop Linköping Runt
price_range: Gratis för LGIF-medlemmar; övriga deltagare pris ej angivet
description: COOP Linköping Runt is a city race in Linköping with start and finish at Trädgårdsföreningen. The race is organized by Linköpings GIF (LGIF) in collaboration with COOP Linköping, and registration is done via cooplinkopingrunt.se. For LGIF members, the race is free with the campaign code LGIF2024; other participants pay the price listed on the website. The event also seeks volunteers and offers a clear city tour experience in central Linköping.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Trädgårdsföreningen, centrally in Linköping
City run focusing on Linköping's city center
LGIF2024 campaign makes the race free for LGIF members
additional: The website contains sections about Time & Place, Registration Fee, Registration, Timing, Prizes, Max Time, Bib Numbers, Start Certificate, Transfer of Start Place, Class Change, Absence/Insurance, Changing & Shower, Clothing Drop, Toilet, Warm-up, Food & Drink, Energy, Medical Services, Results, and Terms. Registration is via cooplinkopingrunt.se; the campaign code LGIF2024 makes the race free for LGIF members; volunteers are sought.

name: Enhörna Challenge
location: Södertälje IP, Södertälje, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Enhörna Challenge is a 5000-meter track race organized by Enhörna IF at Södertälje IP. The competition is open to both men and women and is divided into heats based on runners' ability. The first heat starts at 18:30, with the faster heats following later in the evening. It is a well-organized event with check-ins up to 45 minutes before each heat. Welcome to participate in this challenging and exciting running festival!
course_highlights: 5000 meters on track
Heat division based on runners' ability
Organized at Södertälje IP
additional: Check-in occurs up to 45 minutes before each heat. There are several heats with start times around 18:30, 19:15, and 19:45 depending on the number of participants and runners' levels. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from the region, including elite performances such as Johanna Anvell who has run under 37 minutes in the 10,000 meters. It is an opportunity for runners to challenge themselves and participate in a well-organized competition.

name: Brommaspelen
description: The Bromma Games is an athletics competition organized by Bromma IF that promotes athletics and sports development in the Bromma area. The competition welcomes children, youth, and adults and offers a wide range of events and classes. The event is an important part of the club's activities and contributes to both elite and recreational development in athletics. Officials are encouraged to register to help with the execution of the competition.
course_highlights: Wide range of athletics events including sprints, jumps, and throws
Held at Stockholm Stadium, an iconic athletics venue
Open to participants from age 9 and up, with opportunities to compete in different age groups
additional: Officials are encouraged to register to help with the competition. The office is located at Stora Mossen IP with entrance from Västerled, but visits require an appointment. Registration for the competition is via Sportadmin and includes various events for different age groups. The event is part of Bromma IF's broad activities in athletics and offers opportunities for both competitors and officials.

name: TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 kr till och med 6/9 2026 (Gruppanmälan öppen tom 6/9)

description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world's largest cross-country race, held on the last weekend of September on Lidingö. The weekend offers events for all levels - from toddler races of 1.7 km to the classic 30 km race - and attracts over 30,000 runners to its scenic, hilly courses. The event is both a competitive challenge and a running festival with a Sports Fair where you can pick up your bib and meet exhibitors. The natural surroundings and soft trails are the hallmark of the race.
course_highlights: Hilly, soft trails through forests and open areas: alternating between flat meadows, gravel roads, sloping paths, and steep inclines
TCS Lidingöloppet 30 km: approximately 522 meters of elevation gain
TCS Lidingöloppet 15 km: approximately 250 meters of elevation gain; start at Koltorp and finish at Grönsta Gärde
additional: All finishers receive the TCS Lidingöloppet bronze medal with a unique Carl Milles motif each year; a silver medal is available if you meet the silver time and started in start group 2 or lower. A diploma is provided as a PDF in the results email (a paper diploma can be ordered for 50 SEK including shipping). Enervit offers fueling service along the course (product stations for a fee). Minimum age: 30 km = 17 years, 15 km = 15 years (several other age limits apply for different races). The Sports Fair is used for bib distribution and exhibitors. Lidingöloppet is a non-profit organization run by a club (contact: Vasavägen 82, 181 41 Lidingö; phone 08-7652615; email info@lidingoloppet.se). Early Bird discount (20%) is already deducted from prices marked with *. Plan your experience: bib, partners, and exhibitors are on site. Environmentally friendly travel options include free buses from Ropsten to Lidingövallen, running buses from several locations in central Sweden, bike parking, and carpooling. Limited access and few parking options during the race. Seeding race before the weekend: Vårmilen can be purchased as a seeding race (price 100 - 200 SEK).

name: Tjurruset
price_range: early bird priser, exakt belopp inte specificerat
description: Tjurruset in Karlstad is one of the most anticipated and muddiest running parties of the year. The race offers a challenging course with obstacles, mud, and water that create a unique and fun running experience for all participants. The atmosphere is characterized by camaraderie, fighting spirit, and joy, making Tjurruset a memorable event for both runners and spectators. Registration is open, and it is advantageous to book your spot early for the best price and training motivation.
course_highlights: Challenging obstacle course with mud and water
One of the muddiest and most fun running parties of the year
Strong community and spectator energy along the course
additional: Team registration for 5-6 persons is available, where the five fastest times are counted. Team registration is done via email to tavling@ifgota.se as the team registration form is currently not working. The race is approximately 10 km long, with options for team and children’s races. Medical services are available on site, and participants need to register in person with bib number and chip.

name: Klarälvsloppet Run 21k
description: Klarälvsloppet Run 21K is a fast and scenic half marathon that takes place on an old railway embankment between Forshaga and Karlstad, completely car-free and without steep inclines. The race is certified by the Swedish Athletics Association and offers three water stations with water and sports drinks along the course. The start is from Forshaga Learning Center and the finish line is in Karlstad, where participants are offered fruit and coffee after finishing. It is a popular race that attracts many runners who want to set a personal best in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: The course runs on an old railway embankment, completely car-free and without steep inclines
Three official water stations with water and sports drinks
Certified half marathon with central sanction from the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Start location is Forshaga Learning Center with bib distribution from 09:00 to 10:00. Buses depart from Karlstad City Library to the start at 09:00 with space for equipment. The maximum time for the race is 2:45 hours, with minibuses available for late finishers. Luggage transport to the finish is provided. Medical services are available at the start, finish, and water stations. After finishing, bananas, buns, and chocolate are offered. Sports drinks are supplied by Umara with a discount code for participants. The event also includes other distances such as 7.5 km and longer cycling and roller skiing races; opportunities for corporate challenges and health initiatives.

name: Björknässpelen
description: Björknässpelen is an athletics competition organized by Hellas Athletics Club in Nacka. The event includes multiple age groups from children to seniors and offers a fun and relaxed competitive environment. It is part of Hellas Athletics' broad event schedule and is held at Björknäs IP. It is a welcoming competition that promotes joy in athletics and community.
course_highlights: Youth and senior categories
Diverse athletics disciplines
Held in scenic Nacka and Björknäs IP
additional: The competition includes several age groups from children born in 2014 to seniors. Björknässpelen is held at Björknäs IP in Nacka. No specific start times or price information are provided on the available pages. Includes youth and senior classes, opportunities for medals and personal best performances, and registration via SportAdmin.

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)
description: The Pink Ribbon Run is part of the TCS Lidingöloppet weekend on Lidingö and offers 4 km or 10 km runs for Cancerfonden. The start times follow the Greensta and Koltorp schedules, and the courses are soft and scenic. From 2025, a new category for ages 9 - 15 in the 4 km race (FP-9-15) will be introduced. 100 SEK of the entry fee goes directly to Cancerfonden, and the Pink Ribbon Run@Home option is available as a home event. The Pink Ribbon Run is included in the Lidingöloppet weekend and is part of the Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern.
course_highlights: 4 km and 10 km on soft courses in Lidingö's scenic terrain
100 SEK of the entry fee goes directly to Cancerfonden
New category FP-9-15 in 4 km from 2025 for younger runners
additional: The minimum age for Lilla Lidingöloppet is 7 - 15 years. Start times are announced with the Greensta and Koltorp start groups, and rules for warm-up and start pens are followed carefully. 100 SEK of the entry fee goes to Cancerfonden, and the Pink Ribbon Run is part of the Lidingöloppet weekend, Tjejklassikern, and Kortklassikern.

name: Bollnäs Trailrace 2025
location: Bollebergets Naturreservat, Bollnäs, Gävleborg County, Sweden
description: Bollnäs Trailrace is a trail race offering a unique nature experience in Bolleberget Nature Reserve and the area around Bolletjärn. The race features several distances suitable for all ages and levels, from children to seniors, with challenging hills and beautiful views. The main event is Trail 10, a 10 km race with a significant ascent over Stora Bolleberget. The event is organized by Rehns BK and has a long tradition since its start in 2013, with a restart in 2023 after a few years of hiatus.
course_highlights: Stora Bollebergsbacken with 105 m elevation over 720 m of running
Expansive views from Lilla Bolleberget and Bollebergstoppen
Hilly and varied forest trails in the nature reserve
additional: Distance options: Trail 10 (10 km), Trail 5 (5 km), Trail 2 (2 km for ages 11-15), Knattevarvet (750 m for ages 1-10, no timing), 65+ (5 km), Nordic walking 5 km (no timing). Results, start list, and trail maps are available on the website. The race is organized by Rehns BK. The event includes distances for all ages, from 1 to 65+, with a registration deadline of September 16, 2025. The event takes place in scenic surroundings with varied terrain.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet is an autumn running festival in Nacka welcoming runners of all ages and levels. The main race is a 10 km recreational run along beautiful lake shores in Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad, starting and finishing at Sickla Köpkvarter. There is also a 5 km Energy Run and the Little Sicklaloppet for children up to 12 years old. The race offers a scenic and fast course with a lively atmosphere and lots of crowd support. Sicklaloppet is organized by Järla IF Orientering and is a big community event for the whole family.
course_highlights: The course runs along lake shores in Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad
The surface consists of approximately 60% asphalt, 30% gravel, and 10% wooden bridge
Start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter with beautiful nature and crowd support
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at the partner XLL Sickla Köpkvarter days before the race and on race day. The race site opens at 08:00 and offers services and food trucks. Warm-up occurs on-site before the start. Registration on race day is possible for an increased fee if the race is not fully booked. All finishers receive a medal. The start pen for the 10 km opens at 12:30. The maximum time for the 10 km is approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes; after that, a rope is drawn at Kyrkviken for safety reasons. Terrain: scenic course along lake shores, registration via partner XLL Sickla Köpkvarter, family-friendly event, includes children's race.

name: TCS Lidingörullet & TCS Lidingöruset, TCS Lidingöfemman
location: Lidingö, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world's largest cross-country race and a beloved running challenge held on Lidingö since 1965. The race offers distances from 1.7 km for the youngest to the classic 30 km endurance test, all on scenic and hilly trails. Over 30,000 runners and a large audience gather during race weekend for a world-class running festival that also serves as a celebration of joy of movement and public health. TCS Lidingöloppet is part of En Svensk Klassiker and welcomes all runners regardless of level.
course_highlights: Hilly and soft terrain trails with both flat meadows and steep climbs
Scenic courses around Lidingö with varied surfaces such as gravel roads and trails
Unique medals with Carl Milles motifs for all finishers
additional: Bronze medal with a unique Carl Milles motif for all who complete the race. Possibility of a silver medal for fast times. PDF diploma included, paper diploma can be ordered. Energy services and relay packages offered via Enervit. Bib numbers and honors for diligent participants. Volunteer support and sports fair during race weekend. Free bus to Lidingövallen for participants in TCS Lidingöfemman. Several races during the weekend, including children and youth races, with options to participate in teams and receive medals and diplomas. The event takes place at the end of September 2026 and includes live broadcasts and audience support along the course.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala returns with a new-old course layout and starts and finishes in Stadsparken in central Motala. The race is organized by Motala AIF Friidrott and offers short recreational distances suitable for a wide range of participants - both 5 km and 10 km are available. The event is promoted as one of Sweden's most beautiful recreational races and welcomes recreational runners and runners of all levels to participate on October 3rd.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadsparken in central Motala
New-old course layout through central parts of Motala
Shorter recreational distances (5 km and 10 km) suitable for casual runners
additional: Organizer: Motala AIF Friidrott. The event is described as "Sweden's most beautiful recreational race". The website encourages to mark October 3rd in the calendar and notes price levels until September 28th (next increase). Four distances: 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km (youth), and 400 m (kids' race). Bibs can be collected at Team Sportia on October 2nd and 3rd. The award ceremony takes place in Stadsparken around 2:30 PM.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The bypass premiere is a one-time event where you can run or walk on the new E4, both above ground and through tunnel tubes, before the road opens to traffic. The race will be held on October 3, 2026, with start and finish at the new traffic junction Akalla and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. There are race categories (approximately 12 km), recreational categories (choose approximately 4, 7, or 12 km), and walking categories (Herr Gårman, approximately 4 km). The event is highlighted as a unique "once in a lifetime" experience to be among the first to traverse the new road.
course_highlights: The course goes both above ground and through tunnel tubes on the new E4
Start and finish at the new traffic junction Akalla (Vandagatan)
Recreational class has exits after approximately 4, 7, or 12 km so you can choose your distance during the race
additional: Registration opens February 5 at 12:00. The maximum race time is 1 hour 30 minutes; the competitive category starts around 09:00, the recreational categories have start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and Herr Gårman (walk) between 18:00 and 19:30. Customer service: Gustavslundsvägen 18, 167 51 Bromma, phone +46 8 545 66 440, opening hours Tuesday - Thursday 09:00 - 15:00 (lunch 12:00 - 13:00). Payment for individuals via card, Klarna invoice, or Swish; corporate invoices are only offered for groups of 20+ via special contact. Registration is binding and personal. Registration opens February 5 at 12:00; the first stage Hjulsta - Häggvik is planned to open at the end of 2026; the entire Stockholm Bypass will be completed in 2030; start places are sold through Marathongruppen; the race offers bib number, timing, finish line service, and medal; approximately 10,000 start places were sold in the first hour.

name: Taifspelen
location: Bredstorps IP, Tranås, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Taifspelen is an athletics competition organized by Tranås AIF FIF at Bredstorps IP, also known as Siw Dahlgren Arena. The event is held on the last Sunday of September and is open to participants from 7 years old up to adults. It is often the last chance of the season to set a personal record, and the event attracts many participants, making it a popular and well-attended competition in the region.
course_highlights: The competition is held at Bredstorps IP, also called Siw Dahlgren Arena
Open to everyone from 7 years old to adults
Last chance of the season to set a personal record
additional: The timetable is published on easyrecord.se and is also available for download. The goal is to minimize conflicts between competitions, but some overlaps may occur. Veterans participate but there are limitations in veteran classes. The arena honors volunteer leaders through the unofficial name Siw Dahlgren Arena. The competition takes place at Bredstorps IP, focusing on creating an inclusive and inspiring competitive environment for all participants. It is an opportunity to challenge oneself and participate in a friendly athletics weekend.

name: Hostruset

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 700 m Barn 3-7 år 50 kr (80 kr efteranmälan)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 60+ och Motion 150 kr (250 kr efteranmälan)

description: The Autumn Run is a fast-paced 5 km race in Örebro with start and finish at Björkhagaskolan. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and is part of the Southern Svealands Running Series. There is also a 700 m children's race for ages 3 - 7. Information on the website is preliminary and will be updated for the 2026 event.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on bike paths around Varbergaskogen
Start and finish at Björkhagaskolan (changing rooms and showers available)
Measured course (measurement on 2024-09-08); timing with ankle transponder
additional: Late registration from September 29 (additional fee) can be made via the registration system and on race day (Swish only). Bibs are distributed on race day. Timing is done with a transponder on the ankle, which must be returned (lost transponder incurs a fee of 400 SEK). Parking options at the school are very limited; carpooling or parking at Karlslunds Sports Center is recommended. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and is part of the Southern Svealands Running Series. Parking at the school is very limited; carpool or cycle to the area. Late registration increases the fee and Swish is used on race day. Registration is via anmalmig.nu; results are displayed online via Hug Timing.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race aiming to raise awareness of how important physical activity is for mental health. The race is organized by the association Mental Health Run and all proceeds go directly to psychiatric research. In Stockholm, the start and finish are at the Maritime Museum, and the course is an easy 5 km loop around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. Everyone should be able to participate regardless of background or fitness level - the event also offers a virtual option.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Maritime Museum on Djurgården
Easy 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
Course on Djurgården with lake views and city environment
additional: There is a virtual version of the race (scheduled for October 10 - 18, 2026) and the event offers medals as an optional add-on during registration as well as the possibility to donate. Optional medals and donations are shipped within a month after the virtual race has ended. Information about bib numbers and pickup is published on the news pages (in previous years, bibs could be collected at Filmstaden Sergel). Medals as an optional add-on and the opportunity to donate to psychiatric research; medals are sent out within a month after the virtual race. The virtual race takes place via the Jogg app during the period October 10 - 18 with a special code, and results are displayed at the finish area. Timing is done with Racetimer; baggage drop, accessible toilets, and refreshments are available; Nordic walking and dogs are allowed to start further back.

name: Å-stadsloppet
price_range: 5 km: 150–300 kr; 10 km: 250–400 kr; 21,1 km: 300–450 kr; KidsRun: Gratis
description: Å-stadsloppet is a city race in Örebro that showcases the city's best features along the Svartån river. On October 10, 2026, distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km, and an Ullmax KidsRun for children are offered. The race is organized by KFUM Örebro Friidrott with start and services at Tybblelundshallen; information is updated continuously on the organizer's Facebook page. The race courses are measured and the event is conducted according to the rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Running along the beautiful Svartån
Passing through scenic Rynningeviken and Wadköping
The 5 km, 10 km, and 21.1 km courses are measured (measurer Bertil Sundin, 2024-09-22)
additional: Number bibs are distributed on race day at Tybblelundshallen (ID is not required and can be collected for multiple people). Timing is done with transponders attached to the foot/ankle and must be returned at the finish line or if the race is abandoned; lost transponders are charged at 400 SEK. Some participants receive a disposable chip on the bib that does not need to be returned. Changing rooms and valuables drop-off are available at Tybblelundshallen. Water stations, toilets, and medical services are located along the course; water and sports drinks are available at 10 km, 21.1 km, and at the finish. Parents are allowed to run with their children in the KidsRun free of charge. The half marathon requires participants to be at least 17 years old during the year; 5 km and 10 km have no age limit. Registration is done via anmalmig.nu; transponder-based timing and bib collection at Tybblelundshallen; water stations along the course; age limit of 17 years for the half marathon; 5 km and 10 km have no age restrictions.

name: Ultunamilen
description: The Ultuna Mile is a recreational race in Uppsala offering distances of 5 km and 10 km. According to the results list published for the race on October 10, 2026, the categories for men in the mentioned distances are visible. The race appears to be organized by Upsala Idrottsförening, with registration managed via SportAdmin. The date for the mentioned edition is October 10, 2026, and results are published in connection with the event.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 km and 10 km
Results published (men's categories) according to EasyRecord
Organized by Upsala Idrottsförening in Uppsala, registration via SportAdmin
additional: The results page shows October 10, 2026, as the date and the distances of 5 km and 10 km. Note that external pages (such as Stockholm-updates) require login for full information.

name: Umemaran
description: Umemaran is a traditional marathon and half marathon race organized by Jalles TC Umeå in collaboration with IFK Umeå, starting and finishing at Tegs Centralskola. The marathon course (42 km) largely follows the Ume River via Ön and features a partly new, faster route; the course has been measured by SFIF's official course measurer, and each kilometer is marked. There are hydration stations with Umara sports drink and water approximately every four kilometers, chip timing, and shower facilities at the start area. Medals are awarded at the finish for both 42 km and 21 km, and the 42 km race is held simultaneously with the Northern Norrland Championships for seniors and veterans.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Ume River via Ön on both sides
Partly new, faster route; course measured by SFIF official measurer
Each kilometer is marked; hydration stations with Umara sports drink/water approximately every 4 km
additional: Timing is done with a chip (chip must be returned at the finish); bibs and chips are to be collected at Tegs Centralskola no later than 45 minutes before the start. Late registration can be done at the start area via Swish or cash. Showers are available in the Jubileumshallen (basement level) for men and women. Award ceremony: 21 km immediately after the finish; 42 km around 16:20 in the Aula. The registration fee includes a participant medal, Umara energy bar, coffee, and a sandwich; Team Sportia Ersboda raffles a bicycle among finishers of the 42 km who are present at the award ceremony. Starting times (according to the 2025 invitation): 42 km at 11:00; 21 km at 11:30. Fees: Half marathon 300 SEK (late registration 400 SEK); Full marathon 500 SEK (late registration 600 SEK). Hydration every four kilometers, changing rooms, and showers in the Jubileumshallen. Registration via raceid.com; chip timing and medals included; after the race, coffee and a sandwich as well as raffles.

name: Tjurruset
description: Welcome to Tjurruset in Norra Djurgården – a fun and challenging cross-country race where the fighting spirit often matters more than a perfect running stride. The course offers forest trails, muddy passages, wet sections, and technical elements; choose between 5 or 10 km as an adult. For children, there is Kalvruset (approximately 3 km) and Lilla Kalvruset (approximately 700 m). The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs and is open to both beginners and experienced participants.
course_highlights: The course in Norra Djurgården with forest trails, muddy passages, and wet sections
Choice between 5 km and 10 km for adults; Kalvruset approximately 3 km and Lilla Kalvruset approximately 700 m for children
Technical terrain with steep hills where shoes with good grip are recommended
additional: Practical information: warm showers in tents are available a few minutes walk from the finish line, as well as simple rinsing facilities immediately after finishing. There are clothing disposal stations for items that may not be taken home. Kalvruset has a medical first aid team on site, and all children receive a medal with the year. The organizer is Marathongruppen in collaboration with Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK; profits go back to sports. Group registration for companies; company tents and gathering areas; profits go back to sports.

name: Tjurruset (Haningen)
location: Rudans friluftsområde, Haninge, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Tjurruset is a challenging and fun cross-country race held in wild forest with natural obstacles in Rudan outdoor area in Haninge. The race offers distances of 5 and 10 kilometers where participants will experience muddy passages, trail paths, and challenging terrain. Tjurruset is known for its fighting spirit and is open to both veterans and beginners who do not fear dirt and muddy clothes. After the race, there are opportunities for showers and rinsing, and the event is organized by Marathongruppen with profits going back to sports.
course_highlights: Wild forest and natural obstacles
Muddy passages and challenging terrain
Trail paths in Rudan outdoor area, Haninge
additional: The bib number is sent home upon registration before September 2, otherwise it can be collected on site from 08:30. The bib number is personal and must be worn with a chip for timing. After the race, there are warm showers in tents and simpler rinsing facilities. There are clothing disposal stations for items that cannot be taken home. Public transport by commuter train to Handen station is recommended. Name changes for start places are possible for a fee until September 24. The race also includes a children's race and often co-organizations with other cross-country races, as well as information about registration, parking, and start times.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälan via formuläret på hemsidan stänger fredag 26 september klockan 23.59

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan till Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C är helt gratis

description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a challenging race held at the classic Yxbacken outside Norrköping. The race consists of five laps, each including a tough ascent of 100 meters in elevation over 350 meters, followed by a downhill in the family slope. Participants can choose to run with or without timing, and pole use is allowed; however, pole users are not counted in the timed class. After the race, participants are offered food and drinks as well as free leg massages, and everyone receives a medal as proof of their achievement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg's home slope, Yxbacken
5 laps with 100 meters of elevation gain over 350 meters per lap
Downhill in the family slope between each ascent
additional: Number bibs can be collected at XXL on Friday, October 3rd between 14:00 and 18:00. Late registration is possible via the website until October 1st and on-site with Swish payment. Liquids are available at the start and finish areas. Manheims Säteri provides food and drinks after the race, Fenix Brewery offers non-alcoholic beer, and Finspångs Brunnsborrning supplies sports drinks. Free leg massages are offered before and after the race. Professional timing with chip on the bib. Toilets and staffed baggage drop-off are available at the competition area. The event takes place in October and includes challenging terrain with steep hills and multiple laps, making it a popular and demanding race for adventurous runners.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
description: Welcome to Hässelbyloppet on Sunday, October 11, 2026 - a fast and well-organized 10 km race through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta, and Vällingby in northwest Stockholm. The course is flat, precisely measured to 10,000 meters, and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. On the same day, the Little Hässelbyloppet for children and youth is also held. All information about the course, start, registration, and practical details for runners can be found on the website.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta, and Vällingby
Asphalt for most of the course; start on grass and finish on all-weather track
Two water stations along the course
additional: Race center is Hässelby Idrottsplats (Loviselundsvägen 100), the start takes place on a field 400 meters from the sports ground, and Hässelby Gård station is less than a kilometer away. The minimum age for the main race is 14 years (born in 2012 or earlier); children aged 5-13 can participate in Little Hässelbyloppet. The maximum allowed time is 2 hours. The course has been measured by an approved course measurer and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; the event is broadcast live as part of the adidas Adizero Running Tour, and pacers are available (approximately 37:30 - 60 minutes). Live streaming of the event is offered according to information from the organizer.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a women's fitness run organized by the Marathongruppen in Uppsala on May 7, 2026. The race offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km with start and finish at Studenternas IP. Participants can register as individuals or as part of a team of five people, and timing can be opted out for a simpler experience. After crossing the finish line, teams are offered a picnic and the focus is on community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Studenternas IP in Uppsala
Distances of 2.5 km and 5 km
Team registration (5 people) or individual participation with optional timing
additional: Distances: 2.5 km and 5 km; open to women of all ages; digital registration; early registrations encouraged; team consisting of five people; after the finish, a picnic is offered to the team. Distance options are 2.5 km or 5 km (5 km is measured); start and finish at Studenternas IP. Team registrations (teams of 5) are provided with a picnic after the finish; registration can be made until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start, and timing can be opted out.

name: Tolvanloppet
description: Tolvanloppet is a historic race for all ages, with a children's race in the morning and an adult race at 12:30 PM. There are two classes to choose from, 6 and 12 kilometers, with or without timing. The course is as beautiful as it is challenging (it's not completely flat...), starting and finishing on Ålstensgatan, which offers perhaps the most magnificent starting line in the race world. In between, runners will experience running through Bromma's streets, where the feeling is like running through gardens in apple blossom. This experience is enhanced by many neighbors coming out to cheer or even setting up their own small water stations or sprinklers — each refreshing in their own way. Among other things, this has given rise to the race's slogan: Stockholm's most charming running race.

images.alt_text: Deltagare springer i ett löparevenemang längs en trädkantad gata.
Familj springer Tolvanloppet förbi en spårvagn på Brommas gator.

name: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet 10K
description: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet is this year's most generous race, where running joy meets beautiful nature in Djurgården. With a course that winds along gravel and asphalt roads, the race offers a delightful mix of challenge and enjoyment. The first 600 registered participants receive a specially designed t-shirt, and after crossing the finish line, there is a relaxing After Run with grilling and non-alcoholic drinks from Bryggmästarens. Additionally, part of the registration fee goes to Sweden for UNHCR, making every step meaningful – both for you and someone in need.

name: Nyårsloppet
description:
For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Athletics invites everyone from elite athletes to cheerful recreational runners and children to participate in a winter race on our streets and squares in central Vallentuna. Challenging ice, slush, wonderful winter crispness, or a fast asphalt course awaits those who participate and watch.
The New Year's Race is a pleasant occasion to be a little active before the New Year's feast and to sum up the year. And as some say; "What you do on New Year's Eve, you will do the rest of the year"! So take the opportunity to be active, bring a friend, and run or jog around the course.

name: Kanallöpet
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a welcoming running event along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg, open to competitive runners, recreational runners, and families. In 2026, a half marathon (competitive and recreational categories), as well as 10 km and 5 km recreational races, will be offered, and this year's edition has DM/VDM status for the half marathon. The start is at 13:00 at each starting point, and the finish line is at the sports ground Bergvallen in Borensberg. The race is promoted as a competition in beautiful Swedish nature and also offers team registration.
course_highlights: The race follows Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Finish at the sports ground Bergvallen in Borensberg
Scenic stretch in beautiful Swedish nature along the canal route
additional: Transport: buses are arranged from Borensberg to each start location (half marathon to Ljungsbro, 10 km to Sjöbacka, 5 km to Brunneby) and are booked/paid for during registration (no transport offered after the finish; seat on race day possible subject to availability). The bus fare listed on registration pages is 100 SEK. Team registration: teams of 5 runners, all in the same category; price per runner is 20% lower than individual registration, and team registration can only be done online. Bib numbers are collected at each start location. Registration is valid only after payment is received; if payment is not received within 10 days, the registration is canceled. A detailed information sheet (PM) will be provided later. Start locations: 21 km from Ljungsbro, 10 km from Sjöbacka bridge, 5 km from Brunneby Musteri; bus to the start from Borensberg; registration via Swish or bank transfer; late registration between 11:30 - 12:30 with increased price; bib-laps are collected at the start location.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is organized by Säters IF FIK and welcomes runners to the race in Säter. On the club's website, there is an invitation with the course route, PM, start list, and results from previous years. The information is published by the club on the SäterMaran page and in news. The club encourages participants to review the PM/timetable before the race.
course_highlights: Course route published (see invitation/course route)
PM and start list available on the event page
Results from 2025 and earlier years published
additional: Invitations, course route, PM, and start list are published on the SäterMaran page; results from previous years are collected. The website mentions an attached document with the invitation/registration. Official hashtag for the club: #sätersfriidrott. Contact via the club's office (siffriidrott@telia.com) and responsible web contacts are listed on the contact page. In the 2024 results lists for SäterMaran, information about half marathon (DM) and marathon competitions as well as various age classes is included, indicating that both distances may be offered within the race.

name: Run for Change
description: Run for Change is Hand in Hands running initiative where each kilometer is linked to the work to combat poverty, with a particular focus on women's entrepreneurship in Kenya. The initiative functions both as a virtual running journey where participants log kilometers in a shared Strava club and as a way to highlight the organization's work during larger running events. You can participate whenever and wherever you want - run, walk, or cycle - thereby contributing to fundraising and spreading knowledge. The initiative often culminates in a final event in connection with the Stockholm Marathon, where Run for Change is visible at the expo and in the race.
course_highlights: Virtual distance - run whenever and wherever you want
Participate in the organization's Strava Club where every kilometer counts
Final and visibility through Stockholm Marathon (previous finals have been held there)
additional: Participation is flexible - you can run, walk, or cycle and log your kilometers in a shared Strava club; Run for Change uses a temporary tattoo as a symbol and has previously had a booth at the Stockholm Marathon expo; the initiative aims both for fundraising and to spread awareness about Hand in Hands work with women's entrepreneurship. Virtual run with Strava Club; fundraising and awareness around entrepreneurship as well as support for Hand in Hands work in Kenya; the final has previously taken place in connection with the Stockholm Marathon

description:
Join us for an epic day.
Altorp 6.7 km loop - ‘Långa gula‘.
~120m of elevation per loop.
May 10 2025, between 10:00 and 18:00.
As many laps as you can in 8 hours.
Go further than you think.
Challenge yourself, friends and family.
course_highlights: Altorp 6.7 km loop called ‘Långa gula‘
Approximately 120 meters of elevation gain per loop
Event date: May 10, 2025
Run as many laps as possible within 8 hours
Encouragement to go further than you think
Open to individuals, friends, and family

Skogsstig med solljus som strilar ner genom träden.

name: Mattila Trail Run
description: A new trail race where you get to run on small paths that people have walked on for centuries. The race takes place through beautiful scenery, across marshes, on boardwalks, through large forests mixed with cultivated woodland. You will encounter some steep climbs but will get a fantastic challenge and experience in Finnskogen!
course_highlights: Run on historic small paths used for centuries
Traverse marshes and boardwalks
Experience the beauty of Finnskogen's forests
Challenging steep climbs

images.alt_text: En löpare springer på en stig genom en grönskande skog med utsikt över ett kuperat landskap.

name: Nyårsloppet Vallentuna
description:
The New Year's Run is a perfect way to get active during the holiday season. Now in its 42nd year, Vallentuna Athletics invites you to run on New Year's Eve, with the race attracting everyone from elite runners to those who prefer a more relaxed pace. A winter race can offer challenging terrain or fast asphalt; we never know until race day. Keep an eye on weather forecasts and read our information. Statistically, the terrain has been favorable for running most years, as reflected in the results from previous years.

Above all, the New Year's Run is a pleasant way to come together to close out the old year and something to talk about during the celebrations later in the day.

You're also welcome, see you there!
additional: Remember that the New Year's Run is a winter race and the terrain can vary from year to year. In some years, studded shoes may be recommended.

name: Prästholmsterrängen
description: Prästholmsterrängen is a trail race held in the scenic Råneå River Valley in Norrbotten. The race offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and a children's race. An accessible race for both recreational runners and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Multiple distances including 5 km, 10 km, and children's race
Held in the scenic Råneå River Valley in Norrbotten
Accessible for both recreational and experienced runners

name: Glädjeruset
description: Joy Race is the race where everyone can participate. Choose from different distances. Walk, roll, or run! The Toddler Race for the youngest. Many fun activities on site for the whole family. The proceeds go to Hugo's Foundation.
course_highlights: Choose from different distances
Walk, roll, or run
Toddler Race for the youngest
Many fun activities for the whole family
Proceeds go to Hugo's Foundation

name: Fredsloppet
description: Fredsloppet 2026 is a peace and solidarity run in Sweden held at multiple locations, including Stockholm, between August 15 and October 18, 2026. The event is more than a running event; it is an expression of peace, justice, and solidarity, with support for Palestinian and Cuban organizations. Participants can choose from various distances, including 5 km and 10 km, as well as walk categories and mini peace runs for children. The event encourages individuals to start their own Fredslopp, with the proceeds going to peace and solidarity work.
course_highlights: Multiple locations in Sweden, including Stockholm
Distances for all ages and levels, including children and family runs
Focus on peace, solidarity, and justice with support for Palestinian organizations
additional: 75% of the proceeds go to Palestinian aid, and the event celebrates its 40th anniversary in 2026. Participants can register via fredsloppet.se, and the event includes water stations, medals, and the possibility of late registration.

name: Tjejstafetten
organizer: Stiftelsen Tjejkraft Tillsammans och Tjejstafetten AB
description:
The Women's Relay is Sweden's first women's relay race at Stockholm Stadium.
But it is much more than that – it is a new way to make a difference.
Each participating team donates 500 SEK directly from the registration fee to nine organizations focused on women, which amounts to 100 SEK per person at each relay exchange. We call it charitable exchange rate.

Welcome to a folk festival filled with joy of movement and community!
additional:
Here's how it works:
You run in teams of 5 women, and it is you and your team who choose which class to participate in, and whether you will run, jog, or walk around the course.

The relay is divided into two classes:
- Recreational class 3 km per person without timing
- Competition class 5 km per person with timing.

Start, exchange, and finish inside Stockholm Stadium with lovely loops in Lill-Jansskogen.

Gather your team of 5 friends, family, or colleagues – register today!

images.alt_text: Tjejstafetten logotyp med kvinnosymboler och stiliserade löpare.

Tjejstafetten logotyp med tre kvinnosymboler och texten Tjejstafetten.

name: Gavleterrängen
description: Gavleterrängen is a cross-country race organized by Gävle Skidkamrater and takes place at Skidstavallen in Gävle. The race is qualifying for the Lidingöloppet and offers various distances in forest terrain, including a 10 km course. The event is open to runners of all levels and also includes relay options for companies and friends. Gavleterrängen is a popular and challenging race that offers scenic surroundings and varied terrain.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in scenic surroundings
Qualifying for Lidingöloppet
Variety of distances including 10 km and relay
additional: The race is held in forest terrain around Skidstavallen, with start and finish in the area as well as a bank profile showing the course's variation. Registration is done via the club's website and results are published after the finish.

images.alt_text: Gavleterrängen & Klubbmästerskap söndag 21 september 2025 med sponsorer.

name: Oskarshamn Backyard 6h
description:
Run a marathon distance in a backyard format!

A backyard race that lasts for 6 hours. One lap of 6.7 km every hour for 5 hours. In the 6th hour, one lap of 8.7 km. Total 42.195 km. If you complete the race, you have run a marathon! The first to cross the finish line on the last lap wins.

The course mostly runs on the exercise trail and is generally accessible, though with moderate elevation changes.

Registration is done via https://raceid.com/sv/races/13769

images.alt_text: Löpare på en skogsstig under Oskarshamn Backyard 6h terränglopp.

name: Tyresö Night Run
description: 10 km, 5 km and kids' race. The kids' race is free. See more information on the website.

images.alt_text: Karta över Tyresö Night Run 10 km och 5 km med höjdprofiler.

name: Gävle Adventslopp
description:
Gävle Advent Race is the winter city race that everyone can participate in, young and old, slow and fast.
With this race, we want to inspire running joy even during our colder months!

The start is located below the mini-golf course, then the race goes through the beautiful Boulognerskogen and ends at Boulognerskogen café where we serve hot juice and gingerbread cookies.
Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and there is also a raffle for nice prizes among all participants.

For our youngest runners, we offer the Little Advent Race, here the course is 500m and starts and ends near the stage at Boulognerskogen café.
Before the race, we warm up together with our mascots Snowman and Reindeer.

All information and registration can be found at adventsloppet.se

images.alt_text: Gävle Adventslopp vinterlopp med löpare och julbock.

name: Stockholm Santa Run
description: This year's best race with a Santa-red theme! Santa Run is approximately 3 km, or alternatively 6 km, long for everyone. You can choose to walk, power walk, jog, or run – the choice is yours! A race where you run, walk, or roll dressed in a Santa costume to raise money for charity. Join us for this year's most festive day with community, atmosphere, and joy for the whole family in the heart of Stockholm! The entire city transforms into a running Christmas celebration with mulled wine, gingerbread cookies, and of course, a medal! Purchase your starting spot including a Santa costume today. All proceeds go to children and young people with disabilities, for an active life according to their own conditions. WELCOME!
course_highlights: Approximately 3 km or 6 km race
Dress in a Santa costume
Fundraising for children with disabilities
Festive atmosphere with mulled wine and gingerbread
Medal for all participants
Family-friendly event in Stockholm

images.alt_text: Affisch för Stockholm Santa Run med texten "Your steps Their hope" och en tomte.

name: Nora Marathon
description: A hilly marathon where most of the course is on asphalt but also includes gravel roads. You run four laps. If you choose the half marathon, you run two laps, and if you choose the quarter marathon, you run one lap.
course_highlights: Most of the course is on asphalt
Includes gravel roads
Four laps for the full marathon
Half marathon is two laps
Quarter marathon is one lap

name: STHLM Trail Marathon
description:
Warm welcome to the second edition of STHLM TRAIL MARATHON
All races take place on a very beautiful, approximately 15 km long course. Each lap will offer you nearly 500 meters of elevation. Expect great views and a tough run, mostly in hilly terrain, mostly on trails, sometimes unpaved but also on a few gentler sections where you can stretch out and run for a few hundred meters.

New for 2026
• Be at the start line already in April! This time we are running in early spring, so mark April 18th in your calendar now.
• Kids Trail, a free race for our younger runners (born 2014 or later).
• The Brain Race, a virtual race that runs for 18 days where the entire registration fee goes directly to the Brain Foundation and vital research on epilepsy.
• Course preview runs. On two occasions, we will run through the first and second parts of the course.
• Virtual running sessions in the Heyey app to ensure you stay in shape all the way to the start line in April.

What is not new for 2026
• The course, a tough and very beautiful route around Flatensjön.
• Sprint and Ultra, two trail races that challenge you a little extra.
• Grit, the ultimate test that we do not believe anyone can complete. Prove us wrong and you will earn both honor and fame, as well as some prize money.
additional: All info on the organizer's website

images.alt_text: Löpare i STHLM Trail Marathon, en vacker och tuff terränglöpning.

name: MRC Finspång Loop Trail Ultra
description: A tough and challenging low-key trail ultra on a 10 km lap course with 400 meters of elevation gain. Total distance over five laps is 50 km with 2000 meters of elevation gain. Technical trail on single track and animal trails in dramatic forest! Welcome
course_highlights: Very technical terrain on animal trails and narrow single tracks
Five loops of 10 km with approximately 400 m climb per loop (50 km / approximately 2000 m total)
Possible thin morning snow that thaws as the sun rises (seasonal conditions)
additional: More information is available on Instagram

name: Västerås Marathon
description:
NEW RACE 2026

Västerås Marathon offers three distances — 42 km, 21 km, and 10 km — on a flat and fast course through the city center and beautiful Mälaren shores. The course is a loop where you run 10 km per lap.
Experience the joy of running in a well-organized race for all levels.

The race is intended for everyone who enjoys running, from beginners to elite athletes. All ages and paces are welcome, and we will have ample time to complete the race.

Warm welcome!

name: Gintarinė jūrmylė Krosas
description: The international running competition “Gintarinė jūrmylė 2024” will take place in Klaipėda on October 12, 2024. Participants can choose the 8 km distance, which starts at 13:10 from the Giruliai TV Tower. The route follows the bicycle path, and runners will turn toward Liepų Street by the Summer Concert Stage.

description: “Amber Sea Mile” is an international running competition held in beautiful Smiltynė. The event offers various distances: 0.5 nautical miles for children, 1 nautical mile for anyone who wishes to participate, 3 nautical miles for women, and 6 nautical miles for men and professionals. The start and finish are at the Sports and Wellness Centre, and participants are served soldiers’ porridge and tea. The competition tradition commemorates winners’ names on a memorial stone raised from the bottom of the lagoon.
course_highlights: The course takes place in beautiful Smiltynė, starting and finishing at the Sports and Wellness Centre
Distances: 0.5, 1, 3 and 6 nautical-mile races, according to age and gender groups
A memorial stone bearing winners’ names, raised from the bottom of the lagoon
additional: Race bibs are issued on October 10 from 10:15 at the Secretariat. The event opens at 12:30 on October 10. All participants are served soldiers’ porridge and tea. Registration is open until October 8 at 15:00; registration will not be available on October 9 or on race day. Age groups and distances are assigned according to year of birth and gender. Ferry schedule for participants: www.keltas.lt. The event takes place on October 10, 2026, with the start at the Smiltynė nature spot. Participants register online, and the courses include 1, 3 and 6 nautical-mile distances.

name: Bėgam už Kalvarijos XI
description: Let’s Run for Kalvarija — a road race through the city streets, taking place on Sodų St., Klimo St., Dariaus ir Girėno St. and Laisvės St. The start and finish are by the Independence Monument on Laisvės St.

name: Šiaulių Bėgimas
description: The renewed and unique representative Šiauliai Run 2024 will take place on September 22 at 12:00. THE BIG START. The project’s main goal is to promote physical activity and sport by encouraging an active, fulfilling way to spend leisure time, fostering community spirit and a healthy lifestyle. The run will follow the city’s central streets, passing places significant to Šiauliai’s history. It is for people of all ages, from recreational runners to professionals. The program includes a 700 m children’s run, a 1236 m run commemorating the date of the Battle of the Sun, and 5 km and 10 km runs.

name: Bėgimas Sporto Dienai
description: On January 12, 2025, we invite you to the traditional run commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day on January 13. The race distances and route remain unchanged: the 8-kilometer race starts at 20:00 from the Giruliai TV Tower, and the 3-kilometer race starts at around 20:20 from the Summer Stage. The first 700 participants to finish will receive medals with an exclusive design, and teamsport.lt has prepared prizes for the fastest runners.

name: Egersund Halvmaraton
description: Egersund Half Marathon and 10 km are always held on Saturday, March 7, 2026, at 1:00 PM. The course runs from Lagård towards Krossmoen on the national road. This is a street race that is open to everyone.
course_highlights: Egersund half marathon and 10 km are always held at the beginning of March.
The route goes from Lagård towards Krossmoen on the national road.
It is a street race open to everyone.

name: Ulfstindmila
description: Ulfstindmila is a running event that takes place on May 1, 2025, with a distance of 8.7 km, starting from Tønsvik bridge to Skittenelv school. The finish line for all participants is at Skittenelv school, where there will also be a café and awards ceremony in the gymnasium.

name: Arctic Run
description: Dreams can come true. Embark on The Arctic Run - a marathon that follows a unique trail around a beautiful island of exactly 42 km, in the lovely Vesterålen in Northern Norway. The Arctic Run is an event aimed at promoting the joy of running for everyone, offering a completely unique marathon experience alongside the horizon of the sea and the mountains of Northern Norwegian nature. Inclusion is central, and experiences are also offered for children, seniors, and para-athletes, in addition to the marathon, half marathon, and 10-kilometer events.
course_highlights: The Arctic Run is a completely unique marathon experience on a magical island in Vesterålen.
With the horizon of the sea on one side and mountains and Northern Norwegian nature on the other, this becomes Europe's most beautiful race course.
The event includes races for everyone, from marathons to experiences for children, seniors, and para-athletes.

name: The Arctic Run
description: The Arctic Run is a half marathon that follows the outside of Hadseløya, with views of the sea, Langøya, and the mountains in Bø. The trail turns halfway at the idyllic Dragnes, where for the first time on the journey, participants will see the majestic Lofoten wall. The route is fast but varied, with a total elevation gain of about 80 meters, providing participants with a beautiful 10K experience while allowing extra time to enjoy what Vesterålen has to offer.
course_highlights: The trail offers views of the sea, Langøya, and the mountains in Bø.
The route turns halfway at the idyllic Dragnes, where for the first time on the journey, you will see the majestic Lofoten wall.

name: Nøsen Hundreds Ultra
description: Nøsen Hundreds is not just a mountain race – it is a journey through time, set among the timeless peaks that rise between Valdres and Hemsedal in Norway. When you ascend these rugged trails, you are not just running – you are weaving through the legacy of generations, where the paths you tread were once lifelines for those who have lived off the land since the Stone Age. Crossing the finish line becomes more than just completing a race; it is a quiet victory, achieved through endurance and strength. Join us to celebrate the beauty of nature and the joy of movement – we promise an unforgettable experience!
course_highlights: Nøsen Hundreds 2024 brings together a record number of Fuck Asphalters at the same starting line.
2025 marks our five-year anniversary and our biggest event to date.
It is a quiet victory, achieved through endurance and strength, reflecting the perseverance of those who came before you.

name: Midnight Sun Marathon
description: The Midnight Sun Marathon offers five distances and a unique experience under the midnight sun. In 2025, the race set a new participant record with nearly 9,000 runners from 88 nations. This is the world's northernmost marathon, certified by the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS), and takes place annually in June in Tromsø. The race starts and finishes in Tromsø city center, featuring a scenic route that includes two crossings of the iconic Tromsø Bridge, providing participants with a rare opportunity to compete under the midnight sun.
course_highlights: The Midnight Sun Marathon offers a unique combination of nature, culture, and the joy of running, surrounded by mountains, fjords, and an Arctic summer where the sun shines all night.
The race features a large international starting field and is a highlight in the racing calendar for both experienced and new runners.
Participants get an amazing experience of running at night under a full moon, which creates a surreal atmosphere.

name: Veressjøen Rundt Mini
description: The Mountain Race Veressjøen Rundt, which was first held in 1974, has developed into a popular racing event with significant participation, even though the race was previously only open to runners from Verdal municipality. After a decline in interest in the 1980s, it was revitalized by enthusiasts from Helgådal IL who wanted to build up the "new Veresfestivalen" with a focus on the mountain village's nature and culture. The highlight came in 1995 when ski king Bjørn Dæhlie participated, and the race reached over 1086 participants. Veressjøen Rundt has been a community celebration that has maintained its popularity over the years, with a return to the traditional course around the lake for both recreational and competitive classes.
course_highlights: Veressjøen Rundt was among the 50 largest running events in the country in terms of participants during the 1990s.
The race was revitalized by passionate individuals from Helgådal IL who wanted to maintain the cultural and athletic quality of the event.
In 1995, skiing king Bjørn Dæhlie participated, and the race had a record attendance with 1,086 runners.

name: Arctic Backyard Kirkenes
location: Varmestuen til Kirkenes og omegn Skiklubb (KOS)
description: Arctic Backyard Kirkenes is a prominent event in the Kirkenes region's calendar, bringing together the local community and visitors for a day of athletic challenge and scenic enjoyment. This unique race offers various distances to accommodate all levels of experience, from a one-mile fun run to ultramarathon challenges, providing a perfect blend of competition and natural beauty. The race starts from the warming hut of the Kirkenes and Surroundings Ski Club (KOS) and takes participants along a picturesque route that winds around Andrevann. Participants must tackle laps of approximately 6.7 kilometers each, with the first lap starting at 12:00 PM, and they must complete each lap within an hour to progress to the next lap, with a maximum of 12 laps.
course_highlights: The race features a combination of asphalt and gravel roads, ensuring a dynamic running experience.
Participants must tackle laps of approximately 6.7 kilometers each, with the first lap starting at 12:00 PM.

name: Backyard Tromsø Ultra
description: Tromsø Backyard Ultra is a very special ultramarathon where participants run a loop every hour. When a new lap begins, you must be ready at the starting line again. The course, which is 6.7 km long, takes you through varied and challenging terrain with a mix of gravel roads and trails, offering stunning views of Kvaløya and Hamna. With 188 meters of elevation gain per lap, the route features both technical sections and flow segments, creating a spectacular setting for a true northern Norwegian backyard ultra race.

The ultramarathon starts at Snarbyeidet and concludes with a spectacular descent through beautiful Tromsdalen, finishing at TUIL Arena. description: The Ulvøyløpet is a trail run that crosses the mountain from Stokmarknes to Melbu, where everyone can participate. It is being held for the ninth time and offers participants the chance to enjoy a nice trip over the mountain or compete in either a long or short course. Both courses begin at Hadselhallen in Stokmarknes and finish at the community center in Melbu, with distances of approximately 10 km and under 25 km.

name: Vegabølgen
description: The Vegabølgen race offers several distances, including 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon. The route for the 10 km starts at the school and goes via Nessjøen intersection, Andvågan, Færset, Åsen, the entrance to the Health House, before finishing in front of the grandstand on the artificial turf field. The half marathon begins at Sundsvoll and includes a scenic route down to Vallsjø and back up to Valla again, before concluding on the artificial turf field. The children's race will take place on the artificial turf field.
course_highlights: The 10 km route will be: Start at the school – Nessjøen intersection – Andvågan – Færset – Åsen – entrance to the Health House – artificial turf field – finish line in front of the stands at the artificial turf field.

The route for the half marathon will be: Start at Sundsvoll – down to Vallsjø and back up to Valla – towards Gladstad – take the love path down to Kirkøy – Nes – around Syveien – towards Gladstad – Nesjøen intersection towards the school – the entrance to the health center – the artificial turf field – finish line in front of the grandstand at the artificial turf field.

The 3 km route will be: Start at the entrance to the Health House – Nessjøen intersection – Burshaugen (the entrance to the municipal building) – the path to Kolstadsjøen – Kolstad – Nessjøen intersection – finish line in front of the grandstand on the artificial turf field.

name: Halddemarsjen
description: The Halddemarsjen is a traditional hiking march and uphill race that takes place annually at the end of August. The march starts in Kåfjord, 15 km south of Alta, and goes up to the now-closed northern lights observatory at Halddetoppen, 907 meters above sea level. Participants can choose between a hiking class and a competition class, and the march follows a relatively good cart road to the top, about 9 km. The average incline is 10%, but in the last kilometer, it rises by 20%, and hikers should plan for a minimum of 2-3 hours for the ascent.
course_highlights: The march starts in Kåfjord - 15 km south of Alta - and goes up to the abandoned northern lights observatory at Halddetoppen, 907 meters above sea level.

description: Arctic Alta Ultra is a trail race taking place on Saturday, August 30, 2025. The start and finish are at the Youth House in Tverrelvdalen, located at Sønvismoen 44, 9537 Tverrelvdalen. Participants can choose from several distances, including 100 km, 50 km, 29 km, 16 km, 6.5 km, 3 km, and 250 m. The peaks are Fløya (590 m), Blåtind (621 m), Tuva (477 m), Lille Kongstind (378 m), and Tjeldbergtind (367 m), and the views from all five summits are magical. No climbing gear is needed, but parts of the route, especially Fløya and Blåtind, involve steep and challenging terrain. All proceeds are used to support the development and maintenance of the trail.

name: Oppdalsløpet
description: The traditional Oppdal Race kicks off on Saturday, September 21 at 1:00 PM! The Oppdal Race is a 3.5 km long trail run, along gravel roads and paths, with the start and finish at the NOIL square. There is an opportunity to both run and walk, and the race is suitable for all ages. Pre-registration is possible until midnight on September 20, while late registration takes place on Saturday, September 21 between 12:00 and 12:30 at NOIL. Registration is free, and a trophy will be awarded to the fastest woman and man. Welcome!
course_highlights: The race is free, and there is an option for both running and walking.
Trophy for the fastest woman and man.
The Oppdal Race is part of the Oppdal Weekend, along with the bazaar in the NOIL house.

images.alt_text: Runner in beautiful autumn nature. Perfect for the Oppdal Race!

name: Ulvøyløpet
description: Join a beautiful trail run through the stunning landscapes of Hadseløya, right in the heart of Lofoten and Vesterålen! Lace up your running shoes, experience the spectacular views, and let the flow trails give you an extra boost. Whether you're chasing your personal record, seeking a real challenge, or simply wanting a fantastic nature experience, the trails of Hadseløya are ready for you!
course_highlights: Runners can start from 9:30 AM to 11:30 AM, and families with children are encouraged to start as early as possible and take the short route.
There will be a bonfire at the drink station at Sorgenfri, where there will also be sticks for grilling sausages.
There will be a cafe at Melbu near the finish line, providing participants the opportunity to enjoy something nice after the race.

name: Idrettsheialøpet
description: The Idrettsheialøpet offers three different distances, including a children's race, with courses ranging from 0.5 km to 6 km. The races start at 6:00 PM, and the event is open to participants of all ages. Participants can choose whether they want to walk, run, or jog, and the most important thing is to stay active together!
course_highlights: The courses are between 0.5 km - 6 km.
The carousel is open to participants of ALL ages.
Participants can choose whether they want to walk, run, or jog.

name: Nordmarka Ultra Challenge
description: The Nordmarka Ultra Challenge 200 km is a formidable challenge that takes you through the beautiful forest areas of Nordmarka, Lillomarka, and Romeriksåsen. The distance trial includes many hills and an endless number of stones, roots, and mud that must be traversed twice. During the race, participants must navigate with a map and compass, as the use of GPS is not allowed. The trails are not always clear, and it's easy to take the wrong path, especially in the dark, so one must stay alert throughout the entire race.
course_highlights: A long distance with many hills and an endless number of stones, roots, and mud to be overcome twice.
During the race, you must navigate using a map and compass; GPS is not allowed.
The trails are not always clear, and sometimes the blue trail turns sharply, while a "wrong" trail continues straight ahead.

name: KM Terrengløp Troms
description: Are you planning your next running adventure? KM Trail Running Troms showcases a variety of trail races in Troms and Finnmark, with distances ranging from 5 km to marathon and ultramarathon. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced runner, you will find a suitable race in our race calendar. Check out our schedule to find your perfect running event or mountain race – your guide to running in Norway!
course_highlights: Here you will find a race list with various distances, from short races of 5 km to longer challenges like marathons and ultramarathons.
Whether you are looking for a 10K race or a bigger challenge, you will find it here.
Use the filter to find running races that match your category and skill level.

name: Engeløya Rundt
description: Engeløya around Steigen is a beautiful route that takes you around the island of Engeløya. The course follows County Road 638, giving participants the chance to experience the fantastic nature and landscape that the island has to offer. The trip around the island is just over thirty kilometers, and the only noticeable uphill is at Mjeldskardet, where you ascend around fifty meters. Engeløya features both a war museum with Batterie Dietl and a one-kilometer-long sandy beach, Bøsanden, with an exceptionally beautiful location.
course_highlights: Most of the route is nearly flat and runs close to the sea and the cultural landscape of the island.
Engeløya has both a war museum with Batterie Dietl, one of the largest cannons made during World War II.
From the west and north sides of the island, one can see the midnight sun and parts of the Lofoten Wall on the other side of the Vestfjord.

name: PHS X Bosi Backyard
description: PHS X Bosi Backyard is a race taking place in Bodø, Norway, on October 11, in honor of World Mental Health Day. Organized by the students of the Police University College, Bodø department, in collaboration with BOSI, this is a charity run for Mental Health Norway, with the proceeds going to their work. The race costs 170 NOK, and there will be competition with prizes for the best man and woman. Participants are invited to run 12 laps, where the first woman and man to cross the finish line on the final lap are the winners, while also aiming for the lowest overall time.
course_highlights: The race costs 170 NOK, where ALL profits go to Mental Health Norway's work.
Mandatory attendance and welcome/information at 09:20, with the start at 10:00.
The first woman and man to cross the finish line on the final lap are the winners of the PHS x BOSI backyard.

name: BUL-Løpet
description: The BUL Race, which takes place on Friday, September 16 at 7:00 PM, is a popular running competition that has been held 31 times. The race will be held at Furubakken Sports Field with good conditions and expected calm weather. Previous winners include Emil Hosøy, who won the 6 km course with a time of 21:28, as well as Bente R Midtun and Øystein Aamli, who triumphed in the 4 km course.
course_highlights: Emil Hosøy wins the 6 km course in 21:28.
Winners in the 4 km course were Bente R Midtun with a time of 17:26 and Øystein Aamli with 13:31.
The race is being held for the 31st time and expects 77 participants.
